title: Aleph-1
content:
Aleph-1, also known as Hvedrungr, is the Threnodian of Lahai-Roi and the main antagonist of Chapter III: To the Stars Yet to Shine. It is a Void Storm that erases people's existence and memories, unlike normal Tacet Discords that just petrify them. It is considered the strongest Threnodian due to its existential erasure power, potentially linked to the region's focus on research and exploration of the world beyond Solaris-3, causing people to forget their origins. Denia is its Resonator.

Its appearance resembles that of a massive black hole, but with a blue iris flowing downwards as its center instead of an event horizon. Inside the center of its pupil is a tiny blue dot, and it has a white accretion disk. Aleph-1 seemingly has the same time dilation property as that of a blackhole, while Rover experienced less than one minute within its vicinity, days have passed in Solaris-3.

title: Aleph-1
content:
It was formerly "sealed" behind the gateway by the Exostrider's sword in Sundermere.

During The Star That Voyages Far it is revealed that Aleph-1 is alien to Solaris-3, having come from beyond Solaris through the Stridergate alongside the Exostrider.

During the events of All That Sunlight Touches, Luuk Herssen revealed that 9 years prior, Schwarzloch attempted to weaken the Exostrider's seal on the Threnodian, causing Aemeath to seal it once more, at the cost of her life, thus condemning her to life as a digital ghost. By the events of Starlights from Yesterdays, Aleph-1 has been banished to the furthest edges of the universe by the end of its battle against the Exostrider. Denia destroyed the final fragment of it remaining on Solaris-3 to ensure it had no connection to the planet by the end of Beneath a Melting Night Sky.

title: Aleph-1
content: Aleph-1 is deemed the strongest Threnodian due to its existential erasure power, being known as the Voidborn Threnodian due to its unique abilities to erase people's existence and memories, among other powers. The Shaper states in Ode to the Second Sunrise that it is the source of the Void Storms and all related phenomenon linked to it in spite of being sealed due its influence having affected numerous locations across Lahai-Roi through the substance known as Voidmatter, which spreads and gathers to form dangerous Waveworn Phenomenon when enough is gathered. While its main properties are erasure, Voidmatter can corrupt those such as the Exoswarm and humans into becoming Tacet Discords. According to Aemeath in The Star That Voyages Far, she confirms the theories that Aleph-1 is the devourer of existence and embodies voidance - the dissolution of all things. It is a living black hole with the properties of one such as time dilation, holding great power that she and Luuk Herssen claim that not just Lahai-Roi, but all of Solaris-3 would be consumed by Aleph-1 were it ever unsealed, as it had already done so towards other civilizations across the universe.

title: Aleph-1
content:
However, this power only primarily affects the living. Aemeath, who had entered the Threnodian, could verify its nature as she was dead since as no living soul can withstand the higher-dimension inside it. Though, she suggests during her attempts to head deeper to time-travel within the Threnodian that even a deceased digital ghost such as herself could have been erased eventually when she initiated a time loop. Lahai-Roi has also created many defenses to resist the Void Storms and Voidmatter the Threnodian unleashes, though upon nearly being unsealed, such defenses failed before its power.

Also, in spite of being a Threnodian that embodies erasure, during the battle between it and both the Rover and Exostrider in Starlights from Yesterdays Aleph-1 constructed a recreation of its own Exostrider as a controlled projection to fight the two by also enhancing it.

title: Aleph-1
content:
The Void Storm is a Waveworn Phenomenon that indiscriminately dissolves all matter and existence within its range, causing widespread devastation. While corrupting, its main ability is the erasure properties that causes the existence of others to be wiped away. Those who are consumed find themselves losing their very existence and are devoured, imprisoned in Voidspace where those across Solaris-3 lose memories of the ones lost to the Void Storms. While there are defenses against the Void Storms, they are a periodic threat that have caused many to vanish with the Exoswarm, becoming Tacet Discords. Certain individuals like Warren in Ode to the Second Sunrise also found methods to create an artificial Void Storm.

For the complete properties and abilities of the Void Storm, see Void Storm.

title: Aleph-1
content:
A higher-dimension in the depths of the Threnodian’s black hole, acting like a pitch-black kaleidoscope. Time and space do not flow, being tangled, where those devoured find themselves in a place where linear time is chaotic and are set to fade away eventually in due time while certain structures drift and exit the location randomly. The location is currently inaccessible to mankind at the moment, as with the exception of Aemeath, the living cannot survive the Voidmatter concentration that leads to it since any living entity entering this domain suffers a rapid loss of frequency, eventually leading to the total dissolution of their existence.

For the complete properties and abilities of the Voidspace, see Voidspace.

title: Aleph-1
content:
Extradimensional amalgamations of Exoswarm and Exostrider remains consumed and contaminated by Void Storms. As agents of Aleph-1, these beings share similar abilities through the Voidmatter Regulators on their headsd. Due to their similar threat level, the inhabitants of Lahai-Roi consider them as terrifying as the Void Storms due to being unpredictable natural disasters that devour everything in their path. So long as Aleph-1's influence remains, Voidworms that are destroyed can be brought back.

For the complete properties and abilities of the Voidworm, see Voidworm.

title: Aleph-1
content: Upon its banishment from Solaris-3 in Starlights from Yesterdays, Voidmatter across Lahai-Roi has now lowered and access to Voidspace is now impossible through normal methods. It was also confirmed in Beneath a Melting Night Sky that it needed a vessel to establish a connection and properly descend upon Solaris-3, which the Fractsidus knew and created in the form of Denia, who is MIA upon sending herself into Voidspace and having destroyed the final fragment of Aleph-1 residing in the region. While it could return to Solaris-3 once more, it will take time with no guarantee it could descend without a vessel that matches its nature as the void.

title: Ashinohara
content:
Ashinohara  was a nation in Solaris-3, a solitary floating island walled in on all sides, that was largely destroyed by the Lament. It was the former site of Honami City, the site of Neo Honami City built nearby, and recently vanished in a single day.

Ashinohara was discriminatory against Resonators, who were required by its monitoring agencies to wear suppression devices and be placed on an observation list, for the sake of ensuring societal stability. The populace directly blamed them for Tacet Field outbreaks, and viewed those that dare walk around in public as ticking time bombs.

title: Ashinohara
content: The Fractsidus Overseer known only as Zashiki-warashi primarily operated in Ashinohara, and has been implicated in its disappearance, although the Threnodian of Ashinohara remains the most likely culprit. Hiyuki, the Miko of Flaming Sakura and representative of the country at Startorch Academy, possesses one of the five Legacy Talismans that were bestowed upon the internal factions of Ashinohara by the Sentinels. It is not known how many, if any, of these Sentinels remained to protect Ashinohara before its disappearance.

title: Ashinohara
content: The name "Ashinohara" is derived from "Ashihara-no-Nakatsukuni" , the world between Takamagahara (heaven) and Yomi (hell) in Japanese mythology. It is also used as a poetic name for Japan.

The Battle Beneath the Crescent is a crucial event in Jinzhou's history, taking place in the Norfall Barrens three years prior to the main story. The battle was fought between the Midnight Rangers, the military force of Jinzhou, and Ovathrax, the Threnodian of War.

title: Battle Beneath the Crescent
content:
The battle initially seemed to be a victory for the Midnight Rangers, until Ovathrax's power enhanced the effect of the Retroact Rain, projecting deadly Phantoms of monsters and fallen soldiers.

Issuing a final order for his soldiers to stand firm, Geshu Lin charged at Ovathrax, and vanished.

In the absence of the General, Jiyan rose up and led a difficult retreat through a narrow breach out of the Norfall Barrens, establishing Vanguard Base just outside Norfall Valley.

title: Battle Beneath the Crescent
content:
Following the battle, Jué, the Sentinel of Jinzhou, rose from a long slumber and chose Jinhsi as the next Magistrate of the city, a position that had been empty for years prior. In the Capital, Counselor Changli pushed for the reduction of commercial taxes in Jinzhou and allocation of food and funds to better relieve the city from the aftermath.

Jué also selected Jiyan to become the next General of the Midnight Rangers, filling the position vacated by Geshu Lin's disappearance, as well as gave him a prophecy to guide Rover upon their return to confront Ovathrax. Jiyan has since became a recognized and well-respected figure in Jinzhou and has made great effort to minimize casualties in the military, such as changing recruitment tactics to ensure that combat units consist of Resonators only.

title: Battle Beneath the Crescent
content:
Geshu Lin has not been seen since the battle, and has become a notorious figure in Huanglong as many blame him for the casualties that happened under his command. However, video recordings he had sent back of the rain have provided crucial information that has allowed nations worldwide to speed up their research on defense against the Retroact Rain.

==Trivia==
While yet to be explicitly confirmed in the game, it is likely that Ovathrax was not directly encountered in the battle, and it was instead fought against the Crownless, sent as the Threnodian's vanguard.
The Outrider Squad's Norfall Valley Investigation Logs II proposes this theory based on evidence that the stance and frequency matched the Crownless.
The statue in the Suspended Ruins that Jiyan refers to as Ovathrax during  is actually called the Statue of the Crownless on the map.

title: Court of Savantae
content:
The Court of Savantae was a research organization with various laboratories scattered across Solaris. It was at the cutting edge of research into the Lament and related phenomena since the original lament 10,000 years ago. While the ruins in Whining Aix's Mire were used by a group of exiled researchers and do not necessarily represent the whole organisation, the Court appears to have been disbanded by the present day. However, it is known they were active as little as two hundred years ago.

It is often abbreviated as CSC (Court of Savantae Committee), despite the committee being its leadership group.

title: Court of Savantae
content:
The Court dates back to the time of the first Lament, having built the SkyArk Space Station as part of the Etheric Sea Initiative before the Etheric Sea completely enveloped Solaris and cut off the planet from the rest of the universe. Once the Sea reached the station, it was destroyed and crashed into the Roya Frostlands near the north pole, where it has remained until today.

The Tower of Adversity in Jinzhou is repurposed from an abandoned experiment site once used by the Court.

title: Court of Savantae
content:
The Tower of Adversity in Jinzhou is repurposed from an abandoned experiment site once used by the Court.



Researchers from the Court of Savantae often visited Mt. Firmament to investigate the time fluctuations, despite the cost that it would have on their lifespans. While initially distrusted by the locals, they struck a deal to build Mianloong Chamber's defense mechanisms in return for having their research undisturbed. Changli speculates that their understanding of time manipulation, represented in the Chronosorters, is beyond human comprehension and that they must have received assistance from Jué.

title: Court of Savantae
content:
A group of researchers expelled by the Committee for their extreme methods went on to build what is now the Court of Savantae Ruins with the patronage of an unidentified male Fractsidus Overseer. Seeking to study an ancient civilization they deemed to be "divine beings", their experiments ultimately led to their own deaths by the Mech Abomination they created.

Two years prior to the arrival of Rover at the Gorges of Spirits, while searching for answers regarding his father, Xiangli Yao once explored the ruins of a Court of Savantae laboratory outside of Huanglong, where he found what seemed to be a portal deep within. Activating the mechanism provided him a glimpse of the mysteries of an ancient civilization, but also cost him his arm and triggered his Awakening after he came in contact with an unknown metal substance.

title: Dark Tide
content: The Dark Tide is a form of Waveworn Phenomenon native to Rinascita. During the events of , in the depictions found in an abandoned Order of the Deep Tower, the first Dark Tide was brought about by historical wars between the early settlers of Rinascita, who were divided by their opposing faiths in the Threnodian Leviathan and the Sentinel Imperator.

title: Dark Tide
content:
The Dark Tide is a Waveworn Phenomenon used by the Threnodian Leviathan as part of its destructive nature due to the Lament.

According to the Primus Fenrico, the true nature of the Dark Tide is that it is the "shed blood" of the Sentinel Imperator caused by the old wars of faith in Rinascita, thus weakening Their overall strength and preventing them from communicating directly to Their people.

title: Dark Tide
content: In , it is described by Cartethyia as a form of "Paradise," characterized by the cessation of suffering, hunger, sorrow, and emotional desolation. However, this idealized depiction masks its true nature: a mechanism of mass assimilation and indoctrination associated with the Leviathan. The Dark Tide initially spreads through direct contact, converting organic life into vessels that emit continuous hymns. These transformed entities—described as the dead who "grow mouths and sing hymns, day and night"—function as agents of psychological contagion, spreading madness and perceptual corruption. The process culminates in the aggregation of corrupted souls, which are drawn toward a central convergence known as the "Journeying Paradise." Once this threshold is reached, the affected region becomes mobile, guided by "darkened skies" and tasked with extending the reach of the Leviathan’s creed to new territories.

title: Dark Tide
content: Within the Sonoro Sphere of Avinoleum, the residual destructive properties of the Dark Tide are significantly restrained. The region’s inverted gravity prevents the phenomenon from descending into Rinascita, thereby also halting the fall of Tacet Discords and the ruins of the Order of the Deep seminary. This gravitational inversion not only impedes further collapse but alters the Tide’s essence, rendering its waters unnaturally calm—navigable by gondola throughout the Sonoro Sphere. Despite this stabilization, remnants of the Dark Tide still manifest sporadically, often taking the form of rampant purple-hued vines and flowers that propagate across the Avinoleum landscape.

title: Dark Tide
content: The Dark Tide's main purpose is indoctrinating those nearby into shifting their alignments with Leviathan's vision. Using the basis that is belief, the Dark Tide serves to corrupt other and reduce them as Hollow Figures that endlessly praise Leviathan and used as a vector to corrupt others nearby. Through Leviathan's acts of "twisted faith", during the time it impersonated Imperator, Cantarella and Aalto explains that Rinascitans harbor a "spiritual Dark Tide" within them which has allowed the Dark Tide and Leviathan to take root into their collective subconsciousness with flows into into them. Through this the fears they feel are taken in which allows Leviathan to draw out the Dark Tide when enough anguish is gathered while using this connection to make unseen changes within the citizen's dreams itself. Using the Dark Tide to read the depths of others hearts to understand and use their anger, pain, and sorrow for itself.

title: Dark Tide
content: Once the Dark Tide is called into existence, those nearby will begin to experience hallucinations, illusions, or their deepest fears drawn forth and used against them while hearing whispers that may tempt them into joining. While there are methods to resist the Dark Tide's effects, be it through will power or the Fisalia Family's potions, the ceaseless apparition's brought on a person will not vanish unless one is treated and leaves the vicinity where the Dark Tide is at. However, prolong exposure cannot be cured as Aulus, a Gladiator, found themselves transformed into a Tacet Discord and unable to be saved with those engulfed by the Dark Tide becoming either a Hollow Figure who sing hymns to draw others in or find themselves transformed into Tacet Discords themself. Even the Fisalia's antidotes, which can cure the lightly inflicted, is unable to save those with deep corruption and are unable to have their frequencies be reversed. Even Common Echoes break down from the corruption caused by the Dark Tide.

title: Dark Tide
content: Due to the Dark Tide holding an autonomy property, not necessarily requiring Leviathan to continue it's purposes, Anchor Obelisks, the Earthrend Wedge, and the Light of Genesis are required to hold the Dark Tide back from spreading itself across Rinascita while being sealed properly within the Avinoleum and Sanguis Plateaus. Even so, any area touched by the Dark Tide, especially in mass, is scarred such as the Wastelands itself. Its also possible for the Dark Tide to block any Priestess ability to see visions of Septimont's Auguries, leaving their sight of the future utterly blank.

title: Dark Tide
content: The Dark Tide may also possess and preserve the frequencies of others, memories. This entraps numerous lost souls within it which may be used as fuel Leviathan and its Journeying Paradise's rebirth. This allows the Dark Tide to be used as an entrance to the Journeying Paradise but also a method to utilize the lost and captured frequencies as a resource. In particular, the memories of Caligula were preserved and then forcibly merged with Avidius to allow Caligula a potential rebirth while the frequencies of numerous humans are gathered at Styx Lake, or Manes Deep as Chimera calls it, to be used as a furnace to melt down and reforge their souls to create a crude imitation of Remnant Creatures as Imperator themself did that must obediently follow Leviathan. The memories of Phrolova and Scar were also used against the Rover within their mindscape when they attempted to escape the Dark Tide itself. However, Phrolova's research found by Rover during Dreamcatchers in the Secret Gardens does claim that Tacet Discords generated by the Dark Tide consist of fragmented frequencies intensely fused together, causing the subjects to lack self-awareness. This means any collective consciousness formed through fusion is entirely shaped and controlled by Leviathan, thus the Dark Tide cannot sustain or preserve original human consciousness.

title: Dark Tide
content: Though, despite the Dark Tide being Leviathan's main weapon, even produce special Tacet Discords like Tyrannos as the vanguard, because of it's autonomous nature, it could potentially act out on its own purposes, as seen with the False Sovereign who could act out without Leviathan's guidance until the Threnodian regained full control over the Dark Tide later on.

title: Dark Tide
content: There is also one primary limitation of the Dark Tide itself. In spite of its effects on others, including Tacet Discords, it can only affect the Rinascitans due to their belief in the doctrines Leviathan has spread. For those outside the region, with the exception of the Rover, the Dark Tide holds no influence over their consciousness and rejects them. Though, were Leviathan to manifest the Journeying Paradise fully into the real world, then it may be possible for Leviathan to consume them as Cartethyia describes that the purpose of the Dark Tide, once it passes the threshold,  the affected region becomes mobile, guided by "darkened skies" and tasked with extending the reach of the Leviathan’s creed to new territories.

title: Dark Tide
content: It's also possible for one to escape the Dark Tide’s grasp, such as Galbrena herself. Such actions, however, require external factors such as Chimera and the souls of others like Arkyria to allow her escape, and  had been cursed with her Resonance Ability being corrupted and weakened for a time. Even so, this gave Galbrena a connection with the Dark Tide and allowed her to walk within it through her own mind, guiding those who were lost within back home.

title: Dark Tide
content: The creation, sanctuary, and kingdom of Leviathan. It is a realm that resides within the Dark Tide and is a world where it's true purpose is to engulf Rinascita so they may live within it. One of the main purposes of the Dark Tide is to flood the Rinascita with the Dark Tide so that the Journeying Paradise may manifest into the real world itself. Through the Dark Tide, where Rinacita's subconscious beliefs flow and is made manifest, Leviathan used the conflict Cristoforo caused across Ragunna and Septimont to cause fear which in turn shaped the citizens desires for a blissful afterlife after death, which constructed the Journeying Paradise from these prayers where upon full manifestation, combined with Leviathan's power of assimilation, everyone will be forcibly made to have no thoughts and simply pray towards Leviathan with no will beyond blind devotion. Utilizing humanities terror and "despairing frequencies" in allowing both Leviathan and the Paradise a rebirthing process.

title: Dark Tide
content: Within the realm itself, despite its radiance, Chimera reveals that through Leviathan's abilities, they've simply merged Paradise and Hell together where countless lost souls who've become corrupted by the Dark Tide wander, and, due to the Paradise being incomplete, spatial anomalies may occur, such as time flowing differently from the outside world. Though having Napoli's II lantern with its light or Galbrena's using Chimera can reveal the proper path between the two "worlds" in the Paradise. Leviathan's powers has also caused certain myths such as the Styx Lake to become a reality in the realm itself, being as real as the the stories foretell it - but remade by Leviathan as a furnace for lost souls (frequencies) now known as Manes Deep to melt down and remake the caught souls into crude obedient Remnant Creatures. Though those who resist greatly, such as Galbrena's home town, are cast into the deepest reaches of the Dark Tide, condemning to torment without end.

title: Dark Tide
content: Destroying the Journeying Paradise is a way to defeat Leviathan, though only those corrupted by the Dark Tide can enter it properly unless another method is, such as the Waystones, is found. Even then one must be careful when entering the realm as, even with precaution, the Journeying Paradise will slowly corrupt the intruder until they mentally become enslaved.

title: Dark Tide
content: A Harbinger is a title granted to certain humans selected by the Threnodian Leviathan to spread its doctrine, and sow sorrow and despair among the masses. Influence appears to be a key factor in their selection. Marked by the Dark Tide's corruption, they wield fragments of Leviathan's power, such as the ability to summon its creations and command them. The Harbinger of the Dark Tide are the Anchor of Reality of all Tidespawn, where the Harbinger resonates with Rinasicta's darkest emotions. Those emotions act as Anchors, pulling horror into form and speeding the Tidespawn into existence, especially if the emotions are strong enough which allows Tidespawn to form and evolve further using the Harbinger's thoughts and memories This could allow the Dark Tide to create Tacet Discords from other regions than the local one.

title: Dark Tide
content:
In general, the Harbinger will have signs of corruption on them, though the signs aren't always so visible, meaning one must find the associated side effects. Such side-effects include visible markings, memory loss, and an inability to distinguish reality due to falling into corruption and will harm even loved ones as they become Leviathan's puppet with some unaware they may even be the Harbinger itself. Not even the Sentinel’s power can reverse those touched by the Dark Tide unless Leviathan is fully defeated.

title: Dark Tide
content: An omen of the coming Dark Tide, one that has lingered over Septimont for years. The region it shrouds is known to Septimontians as the "hunting grounds." The Brightcloud is usually noticed during the event a High Tide occurs. This is a sign that heralds the coming of a Dark Tide. It's when countless Tacet Discords swarm beneath the Blightcloud, descending upon Septimont in waves of destruction. If unleashed, signs of the Tidal Blight are noticed which is described as scars of the Dark Tide's touch. It may appear as discoloration, calcification, or even coral-like growths, depending on what has been corrupted.

title: Dark Tide
content: At its worst, the Dark Tide that falls will spawns Tacet Discords where the epicenter of the event will form a new Tacet Field forms. However, thanks to the Earthrend Wedge given by Sentinel Imperator, the energy field effectively suppressed the Blightcloud above the hunting grounds, preventing it from spreading into Septimont's urban areas. Subsequently, the Dark Tide stemming from the clouds has been mostly contained within the lower levels of the Plateaus, and while the Plateaus' unique terrain allows Remnant Energy to accumulate, sustaining the lingering Blightcloud hanging over the area into becoming a breeding ground for Dark Tide creatures, where the Dark Tide's corruption continues to spread unchecked, the Earthrend Wedge ensures it cannot go any further than the marked location itself. Combined with the Anchor Stone, a type of small device manufactured with Tacetite formed around the Earthrend Wedge, it provides energy to Anchor Obelisks, which in turn amplify its frequency to repel the Dark Tide and its creations. This allows the Septimontians during the Hunt to eliminate the Dark Tide and its creations within the Sanguis Plateaus.  Though were Leviathan be capable of controlling the Dark Tide fully, it will use its control to circumvent the protections in place to overwhelm the Earthrend Wedge for a time for the possibility of destroying the device and allow it to spread the Dark Tide further.

title: Dark Tide
content: Alongside normal Tacet Discords, Dark Tide Creations are a type of Tacet Discord born from the Dark Tide. They can use the Dark Tide to hide within it unless someone, such as Iuno, is capable of removing their protection, allowing attacks to properly land and deal damage against them. Each one shares slivers of thought and memory with one another.

title: Dark Tide
content: These are Tacet Discords who have evolved to a much greater level than ordinary Tacet Discords that are form from two methods. The first is thanks to the evolved Dark Tide which has fed on enough human despair, warping that frequency to form Tidespawn, or the second, a Harbinger which feeds them thought and memory and makes them more real. These variants born in such a state are gifted higher intelligence, which allows some of them the ability to speak to others if they please. A few such as the Kelpie Galbrena battled utilized abilities normal variants of its kind should not have due to its heightened evolution. Tidespawn are also capable of disguising themselves as normal humans where they could blend in with other group of humans and potentially kill them unless someone discovers their disguise. They can also create a Paradimensional Tacet Field to set up ambushes and spawn more of their kind through special cocoons inside them. The Tidespawn can corrupt others like the Dark Tide and cause them to see hallucinations if enough of them gather around a person and infect them given enough time, such as Avidius who found himself outnumbered.

title: Dark Tide
content: Within the Journeying Paradise, in the Dark Plane, they also take less damage due to the realm's influence on them. Though the Tidespawn can be weakened and driven back by the Light of Genesis, which may also reveal their true forms and take down their disguises;  Order Terminals may also ensure Tidespawn from forming within the area. Tidespawn that also form in enough numbers can be taken down by defeating the "heart", such as the Alpha Tidespawn, or destroying a cocoon, making them weaker and lose form until the next wave arrives.

title: Echo
content:
The Pangu Terminal can capture and reproduce a unique frequency, known as the Tacet Discord ability. However, there is a possibility that it will leave behind a Reverberation effect when shattered. This Reverberation can be transformed into an Echo through the Pangu Terminal's Data Bank, providing a useful advantage in combat.

When a Tacet Discord is defeated, the remaining frequency may become an Echo. You can obtain Data Bank EXP by absorbing an Echo for the first time. Level up Data Bank to raise the probability of Echo drop.
Echoes are an important source of a Resonator's strength. Resonators can use the Echo Skill of the Echo equipped at the top.

title: Etheric Sea
content: The Etheric Sea is a planet-wide phenomena born from an anomalous Lament event. It now blankets Solaris's sky, cutting the planet off from the rest of the universe and bringing all space exploration to a complete standstill as countless spacecraft were lost with space exploration programs abandoned since many satellites, probes, space stations and the like fell from their position and becoming debris upon landing back onto the planet. Research suggests it is composed of extremely high-density Remnant Energy. The envelopment of Solaris did not occur all at once, and was slow enough to allow the Court of Savantae to launch the SkyArk Space Station as part of the Etheric Sea Initiative to study the Sea in the early stages of the Post-Lament Anthropocene.

title: Etheric Sea
content: It is highly dangerous to be caught wherever the Etheric Sea converges, as it forms new Tacet Fields and disrupts the functions of Terminals. The Remnant Energy makes it a magnet for Tacet Discords. Condensed droplets of Remnant Energy may fall from the Etheric Sea, a phenomenon known as Retroact Rain, and this can be enhanced by the power of a Threnodian.

title: Etheric Sea
content:
Another property known to the Etheric Sea is defined as Etheric Sea Droplets. The droplets exhibit unique quantum properties. Used as a medium, they could help whoever harnesses them into potentially reaching places beyond Solaris-3, such as space, by utilizing them as a gateway. The SkyArk Space Station uses Etheric Sea as its core. Though when some dispersed, some space station sectors became unstable. The Mass Relay Device’s energy core onboard however can restore the Theric Sea Droplets disrupted by Voidmatter to a stable state, clearing obstacles that block one's path.

The Black Shores utilize Anchors to observe the Etheric Sea, eliminating the need for building a Nexus Tower in their headquarters.

title: Etheric Sea
content:
The Black Shores utilize Anchors to observe the Etheric Sea, eliminating the need for building a Nexus Tower in their headquarters.



According to the student Chevi in Lahai-Roi, the Etheric Sea causes a refraction that warps everything in the sky. This causes celestial bodies like the moon to appear differently across the various regions such as Jinzhou, the Black Shores, and Septimont, making it difficult to tell if The Moon and potentially anything else above is even real due to how strange everything appears when looking.

Rover may have entered Solaris via the Sea, and the Grand Architect, under the guise of a researcher named Weiying, funded the Etheric Sea Initiative after it stalled. Their interest is suspected to be in utilising the Sea, at least in the early stages, to reach somewhere beyond.

title: Etheric Sea
content: Aether, also written ether, was the element in medieval science which filled the cosmos beyond Earth. Modern scientists would later use the concept as luminiferous aether to explain how light could move through what appeared to be empty vacuum. It was refuted by experiment in the late 19th century.

title: Exiles
content: Shunned by society, the Exiles are different groups that reject the control of local authorities, and are not an organization with a unified leadership.

title: Exiles
content: Exiles come from all walks of life and form a diverse, mixed group. While not inherently malicious, they have few qualms about committing illegal acts. To survive in harsh, unsheltered wilderness, they make use of scavenged materials and repurpose technology. Each Exile is typically armed with a Tacetite Weapon, obtained through illegal means, to defend against threat of TDs or rival Exile gangs. To become an Exile, one must defeat another Exile— whether by taking their life, stealing their Ring, or seizing it by force, a symbol of severance from mainstream society.

title: Exiles
content: Jinzhou's stance toward the Exiles is primarily preventative, with security forces deployed in areas frequented by them. For those Exiles without significant offenses, the authorities generally adopt a more lenient approach and sometimes try to persuade them to submit under certain conditions. However, for Exiles who are recalcitrant and pose a security risk, the authorities are quick to eliminate them without hesitation.

title: Exiles
content: In the New Federation, Exiles faced extreme discrimination and were blocked from finding legitimate work. They resorted to building camps in the outskirts of the country, which became known as the Lawless Zone. The Exiles formed various gangs in order to survive.

It is related to the technology that composes the Sentinels, and acts as the region's Sentinel, protecting the Roya Frostlands from the Threnodian of Erasure, Aleph-1.

title: Fortress and Gorges War
content: The Fortress and Gorges War was a large-scale war in Huanglong that was waged to prevent the spread of a large Tacet Discord outbreak that swept into Xuanfang.

title: Fortress and Gorges War
content:
The war wreaked havoc on the lands of Xuanfang, with most of the city's men and women taking up arms to join the battle and Mengzhou sending their greatest armies as aid. Despite the number of soldiers fighting in the war, it's said that "for every ten (soldiers) who went to war, scarcely one returned alive".

The war resulted in the fall of Yuan Fortress, insurmountable damage to Xuanfang and the extinction of the Xuanling Bird.

title: Fortress and Gorges War
content:
The aftermath of the war saw the founding of Jinzhou and the rebuild of Xuanfang at the hands of Mengzhou, placing Xuanfang Hold under Mengzhou's jurisdiction.

Lingfang was one of the causalities in the war.

title: Fractsidus
content: The Fractsidus is a mysterious global terrorist organization that serves as the main antagonistic faction of Wuthering Waves. Their aim is to accelerate the next Lament - dubbed the "True Lament" - by resurrecting the Threnodians, viewing the Lament not as an apocalyptic catastrophe but as a sign of necessary evolution for humanity. They have caused attacks of various scales across the world in their quest for absolute power and a distorted sense of Resonance Equality.

title: Fractsidus
content:
The Fractsidus' strongest belief is that, to attain the next level of human evolution, individuals must absorb Tacet Discords into themselves, engaging in a transformative struggle. They are infamous for using Masks of Constraint in order to suppress the body's natural rejection of merging with a Tacet Discord. A major side effect of these masks is the suppression of natural human emotions, ultimately leading to the complete loss of their humanity as their transformation progresses.

They seek to gain powerful allies to their cause, such as Rover and Galbrena, and were currently working with the Order of the Deep. They have completely infiltrated the upper echelons of New Federation society, and from their base in that wealthy nation money flows around the planet to fund their operations.

title: Fractsidus
content: On the other hand, they are deemed enemies of Jinzhou by Jinhsi, the Montelli Family, and Septimont due to their aggravated actions against their regions.

title: Fractsidus
content: There are two known ranks within the Fractsidus: "Artificers", a lower rank, and the "Overseers", commanders of the Fractsidus. At its very top lies the thousand-faced Grand Architect. Some Artificers have enhanced body modifications due to "Hydra"'s work. The individual cells of Fractsidus function relatively independently, although most money is directed from the New Federation, where "Eris" runs the organisation in the country from the shadows.

title: Fractsidus
content:
The Overseers are the Fractsidus' generals, taking on powerful forces and achieving objectives mostly independently. While most members serve as Artificers, the Overseers are responsible for commanding large cells and directing the organization's main objectives. Notably, accelerating the coming True Lament by resurrecting Threnodians and merging humans with Tacet Discords.

The recruitment process for Overseers appears to be something to do with them "having crossed the veil that parts life and death," as stated by Schwarzloch when trying to recruit Galbrena. Phrolova was the oldest and longest running Overseer.

title: Fractsidus
content: All codenames are references to mythological beings. Hecate is the Greek goddess of witchcraft; Arachne was a talented weaver who challenged the goddess Minerva to a contest in Ovid's Metamorphoses; Eris is the Greek goddess of strife and discord; the Hydra is a serpentine creature Hercules defeats as part of his Twelve Labours; sirens are humanlike beings that tempt sailors to their deaths. While it is not clear if Zashiki-warashi is a codename, it is the name for a youkai that lives in storage rooms, plays pranks, and can confer fortune to a family. The Grand Architect refers to the overseers as 'the children'.

title: Geshu Lin
Geshu Lin
content:
Geshu Lin  is a Resonator, said to possess a powerful Resonance Ability, and his Tacet Mark is located on his neck. His weapon can briefly be found in game, described as a massive greatsword with black chains wrapped around the blade and hilt, with swirling patterns resembling rippling waves. Dark flames pulse from his weapon.

Compared to all previous Generals of the Midnight Rangers, Geshu Lin is rumored to have took to the battlefield, leading the charge rather than commanding his troops from behind. Those under his command were said to be very disciplined, though it is unknown if this is out of fear or respect.

title: Geshu Lin
content:
The Phantom projected of Geshu Lin showed him to differ greatly from his current successor, Jiyan, as someone who was determined to push forward in battle no matter how many lives it would cost, believing that surrender would only dishonor those who already sacrificed their lives in battle. Despite this, the phantom repeatedly compares Jiyan to himself, though it is unknown if this was due to Jiyan's own doubts about himself.

In the past, before becoming a Resonator, Geshu Lin was still a ruthless individual toward his enemies, driven to destroy every Tacet Discord in Jinzhou, fully willing to kill every ISA agent that stood his way, and fearless towards his own demise. However, he was still motivated by just causes, being furious at the ISA conforming to corrupt officials while Jinzhou was in chaos and unwilling to stand by while Tacet Discord slaughtered his people.

title: Geshu Lin
content:
Geshu Lin held the position of the General of the Midnight Rangers before the current General Jiyan, until his disappearance during the Battle Beneath the Crescent. According to a storyteller's recount of the event, Geshu Lin wielded a sword blazing with black flames, and rose to confront the threat posed by the Threnodian of War, Ovathrax. Sacrificing his body to these flames in exchange for power, he charged the Threnodian, and was never seen again.

Blamed for massive losses that occurred under his command, especially due to his orders for his soldiers not to retreat, Geshu Lin has gained a notorious reputation in Huanglong. However, whether he is an unforgivable criminal seems to be debated by the citizens, with some arguing that Jinzhou may have fallen if his soldiers did not hold the defenses.

title: Geshu Lin
content: When Ovathrax revives again during , Geshu Lin appears as a Phantom to Jiyan during the rain, confronting him over his ideals as well as his ability to lead.

title: Geshu Lin
content: Qiuyuan recalls his first meeting with Geshu Lin during . During his time as a squad captain and before becoming a Resonator, Geshu Lin was falsely charged of conspiring with Tacet Discords by the Censorate, with the Internal Security Agency sending agent Qiuyuan to execute him. Confronting him after a brief battle in Jinzhou, Qiuyuan informs him of the situation, with Geshu Lin outraged that the ISA would devote manpower to his death while the border was still in chaos. With these circumstances, Geshu Lin believed it was better he just die, swearing that if Qiuyuan did not kill him there, he would wipe out every one of the ISA's agents in his way along with every Tacet Discord in the land. Qiuyuan then revealed that Grandmaster Liang had vouched for the squad captain, along with admitting his own suspicions after reading the man's case files, ultimately concluding the Censors had failed their duty and had convicted an ordinary man. Geshu Lin admitted his resolve to keep fighting, not willing to let the slaughter of their people to continue. Satisfied with the answer, Qiuyuan advised Geshu Lin to harden his restraint, seeing the man possessing incredible might but such power capable killing himself in the future if left uncheck. Departing with the belief that the man will leave a legacy as long as his resolve to protect Jinzhou stands firm, Geshu Lin finally collapsed from exhaustion.

title: Geshu Lin
content: According to Qiuyuan, Geshu Lin had eventually succumbed to Ovathrax's influence and fallen into the Threnodian's abyss during the Battle Beneath the Crescent. Blaming himself for not ending the latter's life when he had the chance, Qiuyuan swears to find Geshu Lin one day to carry out his execution as punishment for the lives lost under his command in the Battle Beneath the Crescent.

The Tethys Institute, a pre-Lament organisation, may have been a part of this civilisation and created the plan which lead to the creation of the Black Shores to safeguard humanity.

title: Huanglong
content: Huanglong is an empire, ruled by its Emperor, out of the central capital of Mingting. The bureaus of the empire are centrally managed in the city, with various branches reporting to their respective ministries in the capital who report to the Emperor and other powerbrokers. Known institutions are the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs, responsible for monitoring Sentinels, astronomy, and calendars, with limited powers over other administrative bodies; the Ministry of War, headed by its Grand Marshall; the Censorate, one of Huanglong's three judicial bodies; the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, in charge of tracking events in other nations; the Internal Security Agency, a secret police with extraordinary powers and specialized expertise in managing Resonators; and Huaxu Academy, the country's principal research facilities.

content: Under the Ministry of War in Mengzhou, the soldiers responsible for guarding Xuanfang Hold are known as Xuanfang Wardens, lead by Paragon Qingxiao. They act as the military of Xuanfang, assisting Autopuppets in defending the region. The Xuan Triad is a special unit formed by the Xuanfang Wardens, composed of three elite Wardens. Members of this unit are also known as Xuan Watchers. The Xuan Triad is tasked with handling incidents beyond the capabilities of standard Xuanfang Wardens. Despite their abilities, Xuanfang is primarily defended by the numerically superior Autopuppets.

title: Huanglong
content: The Midnight Rangers are the primary military force of Huanglong's frontlines in Jinzhou, protecting the province and nation as a whole from the Tacet Discord threat emerging from Norfall Barrens. The Rangers' facilities line the northern half of the province, all the way down to the provincial capital where threats are either flooded, repulsed, or redirected towards the Gorges of Spirits and the pathway towards Xuanfang's defenses, consisting of the Disorienting Fog and automata. They report to the Ministry of War in Mingting. The Midnight Rangers are led by Sentinal Jué's appointed General, Jiyan.

The academy maintains a high level of independence in its research pursuits, while also actively engaging in academic exchanges with other institutions within Huanglong and beyond. In fact, it was once a key collaborator of the Court of Savantae.

title: Jinzhou (Province)
content:
Jinzhou is based on the province of Jiangsu, near Shanghai.
Jiangsu is often referred to as the throat of China or the Yangtze River, and Nanjing's fortresses are said to "strangle the throat of the Long River."
Architecturally, Jiangsu is known for its native Su-style and Hui-style from neighbouring Anhui. Both styles have whitewashed walls, dark-tiled roofs, archways, and winding paths.
Jinzhou's waterways and large moats are emblematic of the Su-style, especially in Suzhou
Guardian lions are popular in the Hui-style
Jinzhou City Hall is similar to the Ming Palace of Nanjing

In CBT1, Huanglong was comprised only by Jinzhou (which was not named), as the other provinces did not exist.

title: Jinzhou (Province)/Culture
content: As a border city in Huanglong and a stronghold against the Tacet Discord, Jinzhou shares much in common with other Huanglong cities, but has also been influenced by it's unique militaristic history.

title: Jinzhou (Province)/Culture
content:
In Jinzhou, leisure activities revolve around watching plays in theater and socializing in tea houses.  The theater is open year-round, and features Hero Plays, storytelling, and Liondance.

The Liondance Troupe in Jinzhou is very popular among citizens, who organize celebration rituals alongside opening ceremonies or intimate occasions such as birthday celebrations and 100-day festivities for babies.

title: Jinzhou (Province)/Culture
content:
As a Huanglong city, Jinzhou's cuisine features many of the nation's traditional dishes. The most popular culinary destination in Jinzhou is Panhua Restaurant.

Stationed on the frontlines, the diet of Midnight Rangers is more focused on practicality, especially during difficult times when resources are scarce. Food Ration Bars are a staple for the Garrison, with each serving coming with a message to soldiers expressing support.

title: Jinzhou (Province)/Culture
content: Due to Jinzhou's history of war against the Tacet Discord, they are often linked to catastrophes and suffering and thus despised. While Echoes are frequently deployed as tools of warfare, they are rarely admired, seen roaming freely, or used for companionship.

title: Jinzhou (Province)/Culture
content: The Huaxu Academy campus located in Jinzhou has produced numerous groundbreaking research results due to its focus on advancing science and technology in the face of the ongoing war against Tacet Discord. The institution specializes in in Wutherology, Ecoacoustics, and Resonology. Xiangli Yao is the academy's Principal Investigator.

title: Jinzhou (Province)/Culture
content:
The land of Jinzhou is rich in high-quality minerals, such as Lampylumen, and mining is a very common occupation. The Huaipu Mining Firm, owned by Fuyan, has a near-monopoly over this industry.

Buying everyday essentials such as groceries makes up a large portion of living expenses for Jinzhou citizens.

title: Jinzhou (Province)/Culture
content: A festival that takes place inside Jinzhou City, where the streets will be bustling with activity, filled with bouquets and drums of Liondance. Normally, people welcome it with cleaning while merchants release new products to celebrate the arrival of a brand new year.

title: Jinzhou (Province)/Culture
content: The Magistrate is the head of Jinzhou's government, responsible for addressing political and military affairs as well as the concerns of the citizens. While the Magistrate has the final say in admirative affairs, they are guided by Jué, the Guardian Sentinel of Jinzhou, and work with the City Hall to make these decisions. Magistrates are the only individuals with access to Jinzhou's Grand Library. The current Magistrate is Jinhsi. According to Chixia, all of the previous Magistrates selected by Jué had performed their duties well.

title: Jinzhou (Province)/Culture
content: At the core of Jinzhou’s governance structure is City Hall, a parliamentary body where crucial decisions are made for the city. Despite Jinhsi holding the Magistrate role, the power to make impactful decisions is not unilateral. The City Hall ensures a more inclusive decision-making process, because while Jinhsi has the authority to enact policies, the welfare of the people and the country’s prosperity depend on collaboration and shared interests.

title: Jinzhou (Province)/Culture
content: For a nation with its wealth dependent on their citizens, the more productivity, the better. Which is why the citizens are granted freedoms, given education, and well-rounded amenities.  Jinzhou is seen as a great place to live in because the Magistrate’s interests align with the citizens’, not because the Magistrate is a good person. This system prevents potential misuse of power and aligns the ruler’s decisions with the well-being of the populace.

title: Jinzhou (Province)/Culture
content:
The Ministry of Development takes on the responsibility of safeguarding the general welfare and public services. Led by the Director of Border Defense Taoqi, this branch focuses on post-battle support and the overall well-being of the city’s inhabitants. Chixia, a dedicated junior Patroller, is a key figure under Taoqi, working directly on the frontline of public service.

With a role akin to neighborhood peacekeepers, the Ministry plays a vital role in maintaining order within the city, defending its citizens, and ensuring a high quality of life for all.

title: Jinzhou (Province)/Culture
content: The Ministry of War presides over the military affairs of Jinzhou. The Midnight Rangers are under their jurisdiction.

title: Jinzhou (Province)/Culture
content:
Jinzhou has always been a crucial defense against the Tacet Discord Outbreaks and the Midnight Rangers defend the northern border without falter, safeguarding Huanglong. As the primary military force, the Midnight Rangers are tasked with protecting the nation from external threats.

They are divided in the Vanguard for offensive operations against Tacet Discords and the Rearguard to protect the city. The Outriders operate independent from the main troop, focusing on gathering vital information about enemy territories. Their mobility and combat prowess make them essential in navigating uncharted territories and uncovering potential threats.

This military branch is integral to Huanglong’s defense strategy, deploying wherever the nation’s enemies pose a threat. The Midnight Rangers garrison in Jinzhou is led by General Jiyan.

title: Jinzhou (Province)/History
content: A timeline of historical events that have taken place within Jinzhou and Mt. Firmament.

title: Jinzhou (Province)/History
content:
During ancient times, Jué descends upon Mt. Firmament alongside a colossal vehicle that serves as its hibernation pod. Having sustained serious injuries, the Sentinel loses the ability to restore time, instead only being able to stop and rewind it.

A large horde of Tacet Discords attack Huanglong. Hongzhen suffers greatly from this outbreak, so Jué erects a barrier of slowed time around all of Mt. Firmament to protect the people on the island.
Rover experiences the placement of this temporal barrier.

title: Jinzhou (Province)/History
content:
~200 years before LD
Battle of Gorges of Spirits (also called the Fortress and Gorges War)
Soldiers of Huanglong safeguard their nation against approaching Tacet Discord in the Gorges of Spirits. In the midst of the battle, "The First Resonator" descends and defeats the Crownless in combat. Three days later, the army achieves victory, marking the founding of Jinzhou in that same year.

The Sonoro Sphere would only activate when Mt. Firmament's flow of time was restored. The only way to escape the Sonoro was to burn it down without injuring anyone within, which Xuanmiao meant as an ultimate test for Changli. Xuanmiao mentions a new city being established.

title: Jinzhou (Province)/History
content:
20 years before LD — Jinzhou experiences a NovaFei pandemic. The highly contagious disease primarily affects children under six years old, with severe symptoms including fever, limb pain, and muscle atrophy.
The vaccine is distributed in the form of candy pearls. Xiangli Yao, at 7 months old, is the test subject for this vaccine.
Rover helps ensure that the vaccine is successfully transported to Jinzhou, defending against Tacet Discord.

10 years before LD — The Riverside Games is won by a 'temporary' team of Midnight Rangers recruits, including Jiyan, who set a record. A large TD outbreak occurs soon after in Desorock Highland, and due to a shortage of troops, the latest recruits are sent in as reinforcements as a last resort. The majority of them die in the battle, and their frequencies continue to fight for the next decade against merging with the TDs.

title: Jinzhou (Province)/History

General Geshu Lin leads the Midnight Rangers in an attack against Ovathrax, the Threnodian of War. However, Ovathrax enhances the effects of the Retroact Rain for the first time, causing immense carnage.
After issuing a final order for his soldiers not to retreat, Geshu Lin confronts Ovathrax, injuring it but vanishing in the process. Jiyan leads a retreat with the remaining soldiers.

title: Jué
Jué
content: Huanglong's original Sentinel was one of the Sentinels created by the Homeland Civilization to defend Solaris-3 from the threat of the Threnodians. This Sentinel was delivered by an Exostrider to Solaris-3. The original Sentinel was then split into seven Sentinels, each descending on and guarding a province of the nation. One of the seven Sentinels is Jué, who descended upon Mt. Firmament.

title: Jué
content: In ancient times, Jué descended on Mt. Firmament alongside a colossal vehicle, which would later come to be known as the Mianloong Chamber. The early settlers of Hongzhen believed that the Sentinel originated from a faraway star and that its vehicle served as its hibernation pod. As part of its directive to protect and safeguard civilization, Jué created a Temporal Barrier to protect the citizens of Hongzhen from Tacet Discords—greatly affecting the flow of time within the area. Due to this act, the people of Hongzhen revere the Sentinel, who safeguards their town, praying devotedly for its blessing of lasting prosperity and longevity. They eventually carved its likeness onto the mountain itself, creating Loong's Crest.

title: Jué
content: A report from the Court of Savantae, which had dubbed the Sentinel C-001, confirmed that it had sustained serious injuries—injuries that surpassed even its natural state of immortality. Alongside these injuries, the Sentinel had also lost one of its Temporal Programs, a key component of its complete dominion over the Temporal Mandate. In its prime, Jué had the ability to manipulate time—decelerating, halting, rewinding it, and making corrections as needed. However, with the loss of one of its Programs, it could now only stop and reverse the flow of time. Jué concluded that, eventually, it would perish, and could only use the Mianloong Chamber to temporarily stabilize its condition and replenish its energy, delaying its inevitable demise. Its current condition could only be described as one of sickness, with irreversible disruptions to time rendering any attempts at correction or restoration ineffective. According to Jué, should it eventually die, the uncontrolled time flow—Temporal Disruptions, would expand beyond Mt. Firmament, endangering Jinzhou.

title: Jué
content:
The Sentinel, still adhering to its directive from its Arbiter, continued its duty of safeguarding civilization—Jinzhou, and by extension, Hongzhen—at the cost of its own life force, frequently returning to the Mianloong Chamber to sustain itself.

Recognizing the threat posed by the Sentinel's impending demise, a "peculiar visitor" collaborated with the Court of Savantae, leading to the creation of the Chronosorters. These artificial Resonance Objects were designed as a temporary aid to the Sentinel, tasked with correcting the temporal distortions currently affecting Mt. Firmament by resonating with the Sentinel. This collaboration continued and eventually contributed to the development of the Secondary Resonance Awakening Theory after several failed attempts.

title: Jué
content: [[File:Jue ReversesDeath 4K.png|thumb|424x424px| The Sentinel reversing time to save Jinhsi in the official featured cinematic, "AS FATE HAS DECREED".|left]]While Jinzhou was under siege from a numerous Tacet Discords, a mother and the infant Jinhsi sought refuge in the ruins, attempting to evade the Tacet Discords. The mother was ultimately killed while protecting her child, and the infant's survival became highly unlikely as its cries diminished and ceased within minutes. The infant's cries, however, exhibited a unique Resonance that was detected by the Sentinel. Responding to their Resonance, Jué found the infant and utilized its temporal capabilities to dispel the surrounding threats. Unfortunately, the infant had already passed.

title: Jué
content: Utilizing the temporal anomalies of Mt. Firmament, the Sentinel was able to reverse the infant’s death, effectively resurrecting it. Once restored, the infant was designated as the Sentinel's Appointed Resonator, a role of significant influence. Unbeknownst to many, the infant had also inherited the Sentinel's Temporal Program, including the one it had lost, due to its Resonance Ability. The individual would later ascend to the position of Magistrate of Jinzhou.

title: Jué
content: After the events of the Main Quest: Thaw of Eons, Jinhsi inherits the Temporal Mandate through her Secondary Resonance Awakening after its transfer was approved by the Sentinel's Arbiter. The Temporal Disruptions present in Mt. Firmament have subsided due to the re-completion of the Sentinel's Temporal Programs within Jinhsi. Jué vows to only offer aid when it is truly needed since the Magistrate of Jinzhou has fully assumed their mantle of leadership.

title: KU-Roro
content:
They are Kuro Games mascots.
KU-Roro were first seen in the previous Kuro Games game, Punishing Gray Raven.
KU-Roro names are code names, with their full name being numbers.
While each KU-Roro have their own set of duties that are identifiable by their coatings, each individual differs still. Such example is a KU-Roro Gardener or KU-Roro Medic is capable of taking up arms during emergencies, while other KU-Roro's have zero self defense.

title: Lahai-Roi
content: Lahai-Roi is one of the nations located on Solaris-3, and the third nation visited by Rover. It is a warm and humid region located at one of Solaris' poles under the Roya Frostlands, after ancient planetary shifts during the first Global Lament transformed the once-lush forests at the surface into a region covered in snow most of the year that is now sparsely populated. After the second Global Lament, where the massive mecha Exostrider and Threnodian Aleph-1 descended through the Stridergate, the displaced native Roya Tribe were guided to move their major settlements underground in the aftermath.

title: Lahai-Roi
content: Startorch Academy and other research facilities, built by the multinational non-profit Spacetrek Collective, lie underneath the ice fields. Lahai-Roi is frequently cut off from the rest of Solaris by the Void Storm, a local kind of Waveworn Phenomenon, and does not have a Sentinel, although the Collective calls the Exostrider a "Sentinel Analog" and current research suggests that like the Sentinels it was made with technology from the same civilization.

title: Lahai-Roi
content: Lahai-Roi is equipped with an artificial, digital sky and was kept warm via the light of the Reactor Drive, the heart of the Exostrider, until it was replaced by the man-made artificial sun Helios. The connection between the surface and underground is maintained with the Starward Riseway, a colossal train-equipped elevator built alongside the Exostrider's sword in Sundermere, which also contains other facilities such as the Spacetrek Collective Research Institute and the Collective Factory. Suppressed beneath the sword inside the Stridergate, located within the Dimmr Plains, is the extraterrestrial Threnodian Aleph-1. Before the construction of the Riseway, the Roya had to journey to the surface via treacherous cliffs in an ascent they called the "Sky Ladder."

title: Lahai-Roi
content: The region's wildlife consists exclusively of Exoswarm, mimetic mechanical flora and fauna formed from the remnant pieces of the Exostrider which replaced the extinct species of pre-Lament Lahai-Roi. Exoswarm are capable of biomechanical restoration, although like biological cells, have an upper limit beyond which they break down. Of special interest are the Soliskin, fragments of the Exostrider's neural network structures, which are shepherded and protected by the Roya, who set aside the Bjartr Woods and Solisylum within as a sacred realm outsiders cannot enter. The Rite of Return is conducted occasionally to replenish the Exostrider's neural state with Soliskins. In Royan chronology, the current era, where they began collaboration with the outside world, is called the Twilight Epoch.

title: Lahai-Roi
content: Galbrena picked up her prototype Portable Frequency Cassette Recorder from Lahai-Roi, a long since discontinued product due to the vast march in their technology's improvement.

title: Lahai-Roi
content: The name Lahai-Roi is likely derived from Beer-lahai-roi , a well mentioned in the . When used on its own, Lahai-Roi corresponds to the Hebrew phrase la-ḥai ro’i , sometimes rendered more generally as “the Living One who sees.”

title: Leviathan
content:
This article is about the NPC. For the Weekly Boss, see Threnodian: Leviathan.

Leviathan is the Threnodian of Rinascita and is the main antagonist of Chapter II: Even When Divinity Remains Silent. It is recognized as the Threnodian of Unity, a shadow that seized humanity's "longing for Unity" and shaped by its "fear of the sea" as mentioned by its counterpart, the Sentinel Imperator. It has direct control over the native Waveworn Phenomenon of Rinascita, the Dark Tide.

It had previously been bound within Fleurdelys by Cartethyia, a state that persisted until the intervention of the Rover albeit already embedded in the Ragunnesi's collective consciousness. The Fractsidus, under the leadership of the Overseer Cristoforo, sought to fully revive the Threnodian, orchestrating the events of Chapter II: Even When Divinity Remains Silent.

title: Leviathan
content:
In Chapter II: Act X - The Bygone Shall Always Return, Imperator reveals the truth and origins of Rinascita and its ties to Leviathan.

Before the establishment of Rinsacita,  during the Lament, the Sentinel Imperator guided displaced peoples to an archipelago and left behind knowledge and technology - the Genesis Nexus, for them to walk the path of freedom, enabling the rise of Ragunna and the other city-states. Unity became the foundation of the early civilization. Leviathan, as per the nature of Threnodians being tied to the existence of civilization, emerged from humanity’s longing for unity and manifested as its shadow.

title: Leviathan
content:
Leviathan through its ability of assimilation and corruption, acted in Imperator’s name, produced false miracles, and infiltrated human belief systems from the civilization’s earliest days. Additionally, it states that Leviathan was born from the darker aspect of humanity’s longing for unity, shaped by fear of the sea, and existed as a corrupting influence from the dawn of civilization.

The Sentinel Imperator opposed Leviathan, triggering the first instance of the Waveworn Phenomenon, the Dark Tide, which severely damaged Rinascita. Afterward, Imperator questioned its role and concluded that both it and Leviathan had attempted to shape civilization according to their own will, denying the people the right to choose. Additionally, it had concluded that civilizations are bound to Threnodians and that no permanent solutions exists as of the moment.

title: Leviathan
content: In another version of the story that was discovered by Carlotta alongside Rover - the story had two factions — one led by the progenitors of the Fisalia family — engaged in a theological conflict. This version of the struggle revolved around two divinities: one of the sky, Imperator, and one of the sea, Leviathan. These opposing forces were in perpetual discord, and their war ultimately catalyzed the emergence of civilization, which Imperator chose to preserve as part of its intrinsic role as a Sentinel. In response to humanity's persistence, Leviathan initiated the First Dark Tide, a catastrophic event aimed at purging both Rinascita and its Sentinel.

title: Leviathan
section: Current Day Ragunna and the Rover
content: In Cantarella's Companion Story - A Fleeting Night's Dream, Cantarella reveals that the Fisalia's Divine Trials were designed to find a Blessed Maiden with an unbreakable will - someone who could withstand the Threnodian's influence, thus revealing as to why Cantarella is unaffected by the "spiritual plague", preserving her faith towards the Sentinel, allowing her to reveal to Rover both Imperator and Leviathan's corruption.As a Threnodian, it uses the Lament to pursue its intrinsic nature - in this case, the catastrophic Waveworn Phenomenon called the Dark Tide. Though two previous instances of the Dark Tide were already "thwarted" by Napoli II and Cartethyia, Cantarella claims that the damage remains: "The tall mast of the galleon that is Ragunna has already been snapped in half," a metaphor suggesting irreversible spiritual erosion. Infected individuals become increasingly detached from truth and reality, with Cantarella explaining that "once the soul fractures, the mind will follow until only a puppet remains." This indicates the Leviathan’s influence progresses from subtle manipulation to total domination.

metadata.section: Current Day Ragunna and the Rover

title: Leviathan
content: Leviathan possesses the ability to merge, assimilate, influence and infiltrate human civilization at a foundational level - a bastardization of "Unity" born from humanity's intrinsic nature to long for unification. In the Main Quest Chapter II: Act IV – The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier, it was revealed to have corrupted and assimilated with the Sentinel Imperator during their first confrontation  — eventually assuming a hybrid form of a hippocampus that was worshipped by the citizens of Ragunna.  This hybridization has also allowed it limited access to the Sentinel's core memories and functions including the Sentinel's return pod allowing it to conceive an artificial Resonator to be its "vessel". The unique instance of Threnodian-Sentinel assimilation has led to the creation of Cartethyia, the "Fleurdelys" being the artificial Sentinel Resonator of the hybrid entity. Throughout the course of Chapter II: Act VI - Flames of Heart, Cartethyia reveals that Leviathan had multiple failed "vessels" before her conception, one of which was the gladiator, Mya.

title: Leviathan
content: Leviathan also has the ability to take root in the spiritual consciousness of the Ragunnesi, manipulating their beliefs and drawing them unknowingly toward ruin through misguided faith.  It facilitates this spread via the control imposed by the Order of the Deep and their current Primus, Fenrico. In the Main Quest Chapter II: Act IV – The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier, Cantarella, the current head of the Fisalia Family, reveals that the Leviathan "possesses the power to merge and assimilate" entire civilizations through the slow spread of "distorted beliefs" that function as a kind of "spiritual plague." Its method of conquest is not brute invasion, but gradual internal collapse, where the very soul of a culture is infected and transformed. She also states that it has already infiltrated both the beliefs of the Fisalia Family and the Order of the Deep.. This is further supported by the statements of the Bloom Bearer Ariosto, who notes that the current statues of Imperator deviate from the records of the Black Shores' Tethys System. With this development, Leviathan had already fully seized control of Ragunna through the worship of the hybrid entity, facilitated by the Order of the Deep and its followers, as well as the several supporters from Fisalia Family who are already affected by the entity.

title: Leviathan
content:
The Dark Tide is a Waveworn Phenomenon, regionally present in Rinascita. It can both manifest both physically and metaphysically in those who are affected by Leviathan. The Tide itself is intrinsically linked to the existence of Leviathan and its revival, allowing it direct control over its appearance and the Dark Tide Creations that spawn alongside it. In Ragunna, the physical manifestation of the Dark Tide was being held by the Sonoro Sphere, Avinoleum. In Septimont, it is being held by the Earthrend Wedge, with occasional peaking marked by the presence of the Blightcloud.

For the complete properties and abilities of the Dark Tide, see Dark Tide.

title: Leviathan
content: In parts of Rinascita where the faith in Imperator has not been established, specifically Septimont and the Sanguis Plateaus -  it has been known to utilize the machinations of the Dark Tide rather than "spiritual corruption" in expand its influence, creating Tacet Discords regionally called Dark Tide Creations under the Blightcloud - another Waveworn Phenomenon unique to Septimont characterized by a dark swirling mass above the Sanguis Plateaus. Dark Tide Creations uniquely exhibit the same ability of the Dark Tide to assimilate their victims into the Tide itself.

title: Leviathan
content: The creation, sanctuary, and kingdom of Leviathan. It is a realm that resides within the Dark Tide and is a world where it's true purpose is to engulf Rinascita so they may live within it. One of the main purposes of the Dark Tide is to flood the Rinascita with the Dark Tide so that the Journeying Paradise may manifest into the real world itself. Through the Dark Tide, where Rinacita's subconscious beliefs flow and is made manifest, Leviathan used the conflict Cristoforo caused across Ragunna and Septimont to cause fear which in turn shaped the citizens desires for a blissful afterlife after death, which constructed the Journeying Paradise from these prayers where upon full manifestation, combined with Leviathan's power of assimilation, everyone will be forcibly made to have no thoughts and simply pray towards Leviathan with no will beyond blind devotion. Utilizing humanities terror and "despairing frequencies" in allowing both Leviathan and the Paradise a rebirthing process.

title: Mengzhou
content:
Mengzhou is a Province of Huanglong and one of its six major cities. It is renowned for its abundant waterways, thriving greenery, and enchanting landscapes. Here commerce and Taoism thrive and coexist in perfect harmony.

Under the guidance of its Sentinel Hsin, the people of Mengzhou have developed unique automata mechanics which have been deployed in the land of Xuanfang as a bulwark to repel the Tacet Discord threat, especially before the founding of Jinzhou. Mengzhou borders Jinzhou, only separated by Xuanfang, which comes under the jurisdiction of Mengzhou's frontier court.

title: Mengzhou
content: Under the Ministry of War in Mengzhou, the soldiers responsible for guarding Xuanfang Hold are known as Xuanfang Wardens. They act as the military of Xuanfang, assisting Autopuppets in defending the region. The Xuan Triad is a special unit formed by the Xuanfang Wardens, composed of three elite Wardens. Members of this unit are also known as Xuan Watchers. The Xuan Triad is tasked with handling incidents beyond the capabilities of standard Xuanfang Wardens.

title: Mengzhou
content:
A Martial Arts Championship between various sects from Huanglong once took place in a lone mountain peak here, where Buling and Jianxin, as disciples of Master Jiufeng and Master Shiling respectively, fought. After the fight was over, a mysterious white-robed master, carrying a guqin in her arms, confronted Buling about her conceding the fight to Jianxin.

The Court of Savantae was once active in Mengzhou, having assisted Hsin in building Xuanfang Hold on the ruins of Yuan Fortress after its destruction during the Fortress and Gorges War. As the fortress had been built with the partnership of the Zhuojun Atelier, this unexpected choice was seen as snubbing the group according to some of its members.

title: Midnight Rangers
content: The Midnight Rangers are the primary military force of the Jinzhou region, tasked with protecting the land from external threats. The military branch is integral to Huanglong's defense strategy, deploying wherever the nation’s enemies pose a threat. They are under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of War, and led by General Jiyan.

title: Midnight Rangers
content: The Vanguard is responsible for conducting offensive combat operations against Tacet Discords. They have stopped recruiting non-Resonators in recent years due to the advent of increasingly intense battles.

title: Midnight Rangers
content: The Rearguard protect the city and conduct a number of non-combat roles such as logistics, transport, maintenance and medical care to support the Vanguard on the frontline.

title: Midnight Rangers
content: The Outriders is a detachment unit that operate independently from the main troop, focusing on gathering vital information about enemy territories. Their mobility and combat prowess make them essential in navigating uncharted territories and uncovering potential threats. They mostly consist of volunteers or reservists.

title: Mt. Firmament
content:
Due to the Temporal Barrier affecting the flow of time, leaving Mt. Firmament comes at the cost having one's life shortened exponentially. The longer that someone lives in the Temporal Barrier, the less likely that they are to survive leaving. This is the reason behind most of the people of Hongzhen coming to Mt. Firmament and living their entire lives there.

In ancient times, a colossal vehicle descended on Mt. Firmament alongside Jué, and this vehicle became Mianloong Chamber. It is believed that the Sentinel came from a faraway star, and the chamber was its hibernation pod. Researchers from the Court of Savantae often visited the mountain, and built defense mechanisms for the Mianloong Chamber in exchange for the opportunity to research the area's time fluctuations.

title: Mt. Firmament
content: At one point, a group of individuals young enough to survive the aging, one of them being Rover left Mt. Firmament and founded Jinzhou. Others stayed and worshipped Jué as their god, vowing to protect the land, and carved the sentinel's likeness into the mountain.
