Mt. Firmament is based on the province of Zhejiang, near Shanghai.
Zhejiang is well-known for being mountainous, and for its hot springs, especially in Jinhua.
The province is the spiritual home of weiqi, with its mythological origin on Mount Lanke referenced in Changli's story.
Mount Lanke is also home to a cave where immortals such as Chisongzi are said to cultivate their powers. In a folktale, this cave causes time inside to pass at a much slower rate.

title: New Federation
content: The New Federation is one of the nations of Solaris-3. The country has been described by some as a technology cult which runs deep in the blood of every citizen, and the course of one's life can change rapidly when research talent has been identified. It is known to possess planes and aerospace companies such as Triumph Avionics, cutting-edge photography equipment, and hosts an annual exposition for demonstrating global scientific advancement.

title: New Federation
content: Lucilla, now President of Startorch Academy, was the former chief editor for the country's top academic journal. The patriarch of the Montelli family learnt to modify Terminals while there, the source of the family's highly lucrative Reserved Terminal business. Luuk Herssen was once head of the Novialle Regenerative Group, a pharmaceutical corporation in the country, whose groundbreaking Ichor is dogged by controversy. Its Sentinel is a subject of scientific inquiry, although Galilei says that this research is used by the capital to exploit the Sentinel. While their universities' degrees function like many in the real world, ending with a thesis defense, as Anyad discovered it is not compatible with Startorch Academy's Synchronist studies.

title: New Federation
content: The New Federations's thirst for knowledge is not restricted to technology, as it is also highly interested in matters of culture. Recent research has focused on the origins of drama culture in Rinascita, and it has many avant-garde artists whose works are of great interest in Rinascita, such as The Last Jar of Air Before the Lament. Aside from air, the country is also in possession of pre-Lament lunar soil, a sample of which has been donated to Startorch Academy. Karl, the author of the highly popular book Second Coming of Solaris, is from there. It also produces TV shows popular at the Academy.

title: New Federation
content: There are class divisions in the New Federation, ranging from the aristocracy which Mortefi belonged to, to the Exiles at the lowest rung of the social hierarchy. Exiles have been blocked from finding legitimate work, facing endless discrimination and prejudice. They resorted to building camps in the country's outskirts, and the place where they gathered became the Lawless Zone. Once inhabited by gangs, the central government waged war against them until the Ghost Hounds mercenary group annexed the last gang, and the zone now serves as a source of mercenaries for the schemes of the upper class.

title: New Federation
content: The country has a thriving financial scene, with its corporations having acquired a number of Rinascitan companies in after-hours trading who were forced to reach out to the Black Shores for assistance. This enhanced financial position means that Fractsidus Vice-Architect "Eris" has established a critical base of operations in the country, securing an unending flow of wealth for the organisation by infiltrating the upper class, corporations, and even government with Fractsidus agents to ensure the continued operation of the terrorist group. Verina has complained of inflated flower prices and elaborate competitions. Like Ashinohara, resonators are discriminated against, with Sue White's parents telling her to never return after being accepted at Startorch Academy.

title: New Federation
content:
The country is the birthplace of Dr Scott Rabelle, although he would leave and eventually settled in Lilyland. It is known to have a Tacetite-eating Wyrm. Deserts exist outside the New Federation's cities, although unlike Lahai-Roi's they do not contain swimming fish in the sands. The head of the Spacetrek Collective is a former employee of a New Federation company, Ashridge Energy.

According to one of the movies Lucilla asks you to recommend for her in the Startorch Academy Anecdotes, the New Federation capital is ruled by a corrupt conglomerate of companies.

It is likely related to the Old Federation.

title: New Federation
content:
The New Federation is inspired by the cyberpunk genre, particularly foundational works such as Blade Runner and Neuromancer. Combined with other elements such as Lynae's Cactus Pillow suggests that the country may be influenced by these cyberpunk depictions of America, and particularly California.
Maxim in the Starward Riseway quotes  when referring to an Old Federation saying, suggesting additional connections to Russia and the Soviet Union.

title: Order of the Deep
content:
The Order of the Deep is a Ragunnesi faction that worships the Sentinel, Imperator, and claim to act as the Sentinel's representative. They serve as the ultimate authority in Ragunna. According to the city tradition, the Order's clergy serve as the Sentinel's earthly emissaries, guiding the people with Their divine word.

The Order plays a crucial role in protecting the city by ensuring safety and order by handling various affairs, from city management, diplomacy, civil disputes, and overseeing all Common Echoes. The Order's doctrines are: "Salvation," "Ascension," and "Unity" as per their Codex.

title: Order of the Deep
content: The Order's clergy has declared themselves Imperator's earthly emissaries, ensuring the people remain faithful to  (Imperator's) divine will.

title: Order of the Deep
content:
The Order of the Deep's leader is known as the Primus, who governs over Ragunna. The order's previous Primus, Fenrico, has also declared himself to be Imperator's Appointed Resonator, referred to as the "Enlightened One" in Rinascita. No other Primus has made such a declaration in the history of the Order.

Serving beneath the Primus, Priests oversee the rites and sacred duties of the Order, while the Acolytes dedicate their lives to the study of the Codex and spreading Imperator's teachings throughout Ragunna.

title: Order of the Deep
content:
Describing Echoes as a gift from the Sentinel, the Order employs many in their service, both to assist in various duties, as well as for ceremonial purpose.

The La Guardia are armed Common Echoes that stand guard around the city and only respond to the Order's command, while the Lucerna are Echo lanterns that monitor citizens. Vox Sanctus is a type of ceremonial Echo that cannot move on its own, but preaches doctrine day and night to the people of Ragunna.

Members of the Order are instructed not to get too close to Echoes, in order to remain objective in matters pertaining to sharing knowledge about them.

title: Order of the Deep
content:
In Ragunna, the Order controls all Terminals for Echo use. They store Echoes in their Data Bank and only grant access after thorough screening, thus only a select few Resonators are permitted to carry a Ragunna Terminal of their own, deemed Reserved Terminals in Ragunna. For that reason, most Ragunnesi rely on the Genesis Nexus and Common Echoes, and do not know much of other Echoes, referred to as Reserved Echoes.

Those who break the law in Ragunna are sent to the Order Tribunal at the Penitentiary for sentencing, and those who violate sacred doctrines are branded as Fools and sent away on the Pilgrim's Sail for "salvation". This does not exclude children.

It is said that because Jinzhou has been a battleground for centuries, it must face the Threnodian that represents the concept of war. Ovathrax's statue has loomed over the region for a long time, feeding on the frequencies of 'weapons' and turning Jinzhou's soldiers into Tacet Discords.

Three years prior to the start of the storyline, the Midnight Rangers, led by General Geshu Lin fought against Ovathrax in the Norfall Barrens, in an event known as the Battle Beneath the Crescent. However, Ovathrax was able to enhance the effects of the Retroact Rain, projecting dangerous phantoms of both monsters and fallen soldiers. While the Midnight Rangers suffered great causalities along with the disappearance of their general Geshu Lin after he delivered his final blow against Ovathrax, the Threnodian were gravely injured and sunk into the water.

title: Ovathrax
content: At present, upon the Rover's arrival, Ovathrax had been recovering and was set on resurrecting itself. With the support and aid of countless Resonators and the Midnight Rangers, both Rover and Jiyan set out to defeat the Threnodian. Though they were unable to face Ovathrax directly, the defeat of the Crownless and Dreamless caused Ovathrax to mysteriously leave and vanish, ending the battle between it and its army against Jinzhou. Its current whereabouts being unknown.

content:
It is likely that Ovathrax's exact identity is not entirely accurate.
The Outrider Squad's Norfall Valley Investigation Logs II states that the stance and frequency of the creature fought during the Battle Beneath the Crescent matched the Crownless, and it was likely sent as a Vanguard.
The statue in the Suspended Ruins that Jiyan refers to as Ovathrax during  is actually called the Statue of the Crownless on the map.

Overclocking is a state where a Resonator has lost control of their Forte as a result of overwhelming psychological stress or overexertion of their Resonance Ability. The loss of control causes the Resonator’s Resonance Energy to overflow, potentially harming both the Resonator and their surroundings.

title: Overclocking
content: The exact effects of Overclocking depend on the Resonator's Forte and so the symptoms of Overclocking and the severity and type of damage it causes are unique to each Resonator.  In some cases Overclocking causes permanent changes to the Resonator's appearance and physique. It may even lead to a potential permanent transformation, though it could be reversed as one case seen in Camellya is confirmed who acknowledges her transformation was undone in time. At its worst, Overclocking can lead to the death of the Resonator and/or other people in cases where the overflowing Resonance Energy causes disasters like blizzards or large uncontrollable fires. Overclocking can also affect a Resonator's mind where language abilities degenerated.

title: Overclocking
content:
In some rare cases the Overclocking of one or more resonators at once has led to a formation of a new Tacet Field. There are also cases where the Overclocking and eventual death of a resonator has created a Sonoro Sphere. A Sonoro Sphere that was formed this way, will reflect the personality and emotions of its creator during their last moments. Currently there are two Forgery Challenges that are inside Sonoro Spheres with this kind of origin: Flaming Remnants in Port City of Guixu and Misty Forest in Dim Forest.

According to Camellya, she also explains that once severe Overclocking symptoms appear, the person can no longer be cured. Camellya being an example of this as she is noted to being in a medical pod at set periods to manage her health properly, and even then experiences brief moments of pain at times which she tolerates.

title: Overclocking
content: However, the documented reports of both Phrolova and Galbrena reveal the potential possibility of controlling one's Overclocking state. Despite the risks, it is considered that a Resonator with a considerable will, and if properly guided, Overclocking could potentially yield constructive outcomes, transforming into a power that Resonators could one day learn to wield with intent. However, such willful intent to Overclock is deemed dangerous where attempts to exploit the power gained from the action, as the Fractsidus themselves are known to do, can still lead to death and shouldn't be carelessly replicated.

title: Overclocking
content: Because Overclocking is dangerous to Resonators and their surroundings, scientists have developed a comprehensive diagnosis process to predict each Resonators potential risk of Overclocking.  The diagnosis includes recommendations for preventive methods as well, such as psychological counseling and regular health checks.

==Trivia==
Phrolova has recurring thematical ties to death and the underworld.
The  or red spider lily is a flower that symbolizes death and the afterlife, especially in Japan and China.
Hecate, the Tacet Discord she summons and her closest companion, is described as a three-faced Witch of the Underworld from a Sonoro Sphere where all decaying frequencies converge, known as the "Beyond" or "Lost Beyond".  is a goddess from Greek mythology associated with magic, witchcraft, and fittingly, with crossroads, similar to Phrolova's association with the Lost Beyond.
As of Chapter II's climax, Phrolova was implied to represent the true identity of The Shepherd, since she was known to manipulate Echoes and Tacet Discords alike, and possibly sacrificing anyone to become Tacet Discords.

title: Phrolova
content:
"Phrolova" is a stylized spelling of "Frolova" (Фролова), a common Russian surname (the feminine form of Frolov). The use of the Greek digraph "Ph" instead of "F" is an aesthetic choice by the developers.
The surname is derived from the Russian given name "Frol" (Фрол), which is a colloquial form of the ancient baptismal name "Flor" (Флор). This name originates from the Latin word florus, meaning "blooming", "flowering", or "bright" (from flos, meaning flower).
The suffix "-ova" is a Russian possessive ending, historically meaning "belonging to" or "daughter/wife of Frolov."

title: Pre-Lament Civilization
content:
The Pre-Lament Civilization (PLC) was Solaris' native civilisation before the destruction wrought by the Lament. It was capable of spacetravel, having sent thousands of satellites and nine interstellar probes, including The Farwatcher, into the darkness of space - these nine probes represented by the stars in the emblem of the Spacetrek Collective. The Lament destroyed 80% of their structures and killed half the global population.

The Tethys Institute, a pre-Lament organisation, may have been a part of this civilisation and created the plan which lead to the creation of the Black Shores to safeguard humanity.

content: Natural Resonators have a non-convergent Rabelle's Curve with a gradual, stable rise. These Resonators have naturally awakened their Forte during their growth.

content: Mutant Resonators have a non-convergent Rabelle's Curve with a steep rise in its middle section. These Resonators experienced extreme conditions, surges of energy, emotional distress or a life-changing event that led to the awakening of their Forte.

title: Remnant
content:
The Etheric Sea contains condensed Remnant Energy, which consequently leads to the creation of new Tacet Fields, as well as the phenomenon known as Retroact Rain.

Transdimensional spaces where Remnant Energy is abundant are known as the . The Sonoro Sphere is an important source of information for humanity to understand the history and civilization of The Lament.

title: Remnant
content:
Tacetite is substance that can permanently hold Remnant Energy, and has been crafted into weapons that can damage Tacet Discord. Similarly, Resonant Calcite is an excellent conductor of Remnant Energy.

The Shorekeeper is an entity of high-purity Remnant Energy crystals.

title: Resonator
content: Resonators are the obtainable playable characters of Wuthering Waves, and individuals with the ability to resonate with certain objects or elements and manipulate their frequencies.

title: Resonator
content:
A Resonator experiences their Awakening when they first resonate with the frequencies of something in the world and gain their Resonance Ability, also known as their Forte. When this happens, a symbol known as a Tacet Mark appears some place on their body, with its exact shape determined by what is called their Rabelle's Curve.

For most Resonators, their Rabelle's Curve classifies them into one of the following categories: Natural, Mutant, or Congenital. These categorizations generally follow a pattern of when and how the Resonator experienced their Awakening.

Experts believe that a Resonator's past experiences and subconscious mind influence their Forte. Their genetic information evolves Post-Awakening, and thus their unique Resonance Spectrum Patterns can be compared to samples of Spectrum Patterns of other existing things to determine what they have resonated with.

title: Resonator
content:
Exerting one's mental capacity, an exhausted emotional state, as well as other circumstances, can lead to a Resonator to Overclock; losing control of their Forte and endangering themselves and others. The exact triggers and effects of Overclocking are unique to each Resonator.

Each Resonator has a Forte Examination Report that provides information on their status as a Resonator.

title: Retroact Rain
content:
Retroact Rain consists of condensed Remnant Energy from the Etheric Sea. Since Remnant Energy records events across time and space, the rain conjures illusions of past events to those exposed to it, and a stronger emotional connection to the affected area leads to experiencing more intense hallucinations.

While usually a harmless phenomenon in itself, the Remnant Energy makes it a magnet for Tacet Discords, and the power of a Threnodian can greatly enhance the effects of the rain.

The frequencies of those who die in the Retroact Rain will be trapped in the rain.

title: Retroact Rain
content:
Phantoms refer to the projections conjured by the Retroact Rain. When it rains across a large area, it can project memories of multiple people at once, and in a battleground such as Jinzhou, this would result in thousands of Phantoms of dead soldiers and Tacet Discords. During Threnodian-enhanced Retroact Rain, these Phantoms are given a physical form and the ability to inflict harm on real people.

For someone to be projected as a Phantom, they must have had prior exposure to the rain and a deep connection to the affected area.

title: Retroact Rain
content:
Before it forms, Retroact Rain goes through three stages:
First Stage: The phenomenon appears identical to normal rain.
Second Stage: Water droplets float completely still in midair, as if time is frozen.
Third Stage: Water droplets fall upwards, as if in reverse.

title: Retroact Rain
content:
The first recorded instance of Threnodian-enhanced Retroact Rain ever happening was during the Battle Beneath the Crescent, fought against Ovathrax in the Norfall Barrens, three years prior to the start of the story.

A second case of Threnodian-enhanced Retroact Rain occurs again in the Main Quest Chapter I: Act VI - Grand Warstorm, again in the Norfall Barrens as well as Desorock Highland.

title: Retroact Rain
content: There have been many independent studies on Retroact Rain, most of which were conducted by researches who wanted to relive a previous experience or reunite with their loved ones. However, a group of Court of Savantae researchers expelled by the Committee had attempted a large scale "Artificial Retroactive Rain" project. Funded by an unnamed male Fractsidus Overseer, the researchers built a remote facility where they attempted to recreate a 'divine miracle' that they had witnessed. The experiment was never completed, and the researchers all vanished, having been devoured by the Mech Abomination they created.

title: Retroact Rain
content: Following the Battle Beneath the Crescent, videos recorded by the Midnight Rangers' previous General has allowed other nations to to speed up their research on defense against the Retroact Rain. In addition to this, an antidote has since then been developed by the Academy for the Retroact Rain, minimizing the effects of the hallucinations.

title: Retroact Rain
content:
Dripsnails are usually spotted after Retroact Rains. When their shells are crushed, nearby creatures will hear a sound similar to the rain.
While certain manifestations within the Dark Tide in Rinascita mirror the effects of Retroact Rain, they have not been explicitly classified as such. It remains unconfirmed whether these instances represent a distinct phenomenon or are simply the same occurrence under a different regional designation.

The Waveworn Phenomenon is believed to alter matter, information, and energy by converting them into vibrating "frequencies", and the frequency energy form that remains and continues to decay afterwards are referred to as Reverberations.

According to research observations, once the Remnant decays, it will become a Reverberation, and this process is irreversible.

title: Rinascita
content: Rinascita was known as "Sepunia" in CBT1. It was likely named after the obscure Sepunia plebian family of ancient Rome, who are known from inscriptions and as municipal officers of towns in Latium, Samnium, and Campania in the core of the polity.

title: Rinascita
content: "Rinascita" is an  word that means "rebirth". It is related to words meaning "to be born again" , which is also used in a religious context; and Renaissance .

title: Rinascita/Culture
content:
Art has a strong influence over the different city-states of Rinascita. In Ragunna especially, citizens honor the Sentinel through grand performances, and tend to engage in street festivals more so than attend stationary, year-round theaters.

In Septimont, a common form of entertainment is betting on gladiator fights in the underground casinos.

title: Rinascita/Culture
content: Rinascita is also known as the Land of Echoes, as they are the leading nation in Echo research and technology. Describing them as being gifts from the Sentinel, the people of Rinascita have developed a strong symbiotic bond with Echoes, incorporating them into many aspects of daily life.

title: Rinascita/Culture
content:
Common Echoes, also called "Divine Envoys", are adored in Ragunna, seen as trusted friends and allies. These Echoes can found throughout the streets of the city, entertaining with performances, cooking food at restaurants, or transporting citizens across the water. Many children even possess Echo themed toys.

Certain kinds of Echoes are also employed tactically by the Order, often for surveillance, enforcement, and the spread of doctrine. However, Acolytes are strictly forbidden from getting attached to Echoes.

Common Echoes are available for all citizens who register their information with the Nexus, however, ownership of Reserved Echoes is heavily regulated by the Order of the Deep, and thus most citizens are unfamiliar with them.

title: Rinascita/Culture
content: The Order actively purges Tacet Discord around the city so that their remaining Reverbation may be absorbed into the Genesis Nexus and become a frequency sample for Common Echoes. The people of Ragunna thus believe that Tacet Discords and Echoes are essentially the same, and that this process allows them to return to the Sentinel's embrace and once again become Divine Envoys to assist humanity.

title: Rinascita/Culture
content: Echo gladiator battles are a common form of entertainment in Septimont.

title: Rinascita/Culture
content:
The economy of Rinascita thrives on its trade ports, exporting spice and minerals to other parts of the world. The Montelli Family played an instrumental role in developing Rinascita's economy, having chartered its trade routes.

A notable class divide exists in Ragunna, between the noble families and the commoners.

title: Rinascita/Culture
content: Rinascita has no center of politics, instead existing as a collection of autonomous city-states.

title: Rinascita/Culture
content: While little is known about Septimont's government, they are said to be far more lax than Ragunna, and do not hold as close of a relationship to the Sentinel.

title: Rinascita/History
content: A timeline of historical events that have taken place within Rinascita.

title: Rinascita/History
content:
In the ancient era, Rinascita is known as the Realm of a Thousand Islands.
Well-versed in the ocean, the Fisalia Family extracts toxins and medicines from deep-sea plants, harnesses vast underwater resources, and revels in great fortune and widespread renown during this era.

Riccioli Islands is ruled by a mysterious sailor who was driven from his homeland. He built a citadel that brought the people peace and prosperity, only to vanish without a trace.
According to legend, he left his most cherished treasures on the island before sailing off to pursue revenge.

The Genesis Nexus, a type of Resonance Nexus, existed on Rinascita before it was settled.

title: Rinascita/History
content:
The Genesis Nexus, a type of Resonance Nexus, existed on Rinascita before it was settled.



The civilization of the archipelago is threatened by the Lament and Waveworn disasters, and a group of displaced refugees board a mass of ships known as the Ark and embark on a quest to find new civilization. The trip is hazardous, but the Fisalia family, one of the founders of the Ark, is guided safely by an unknown voice and the light of the Genesis Nexus, leading the fleet to a lush archipelago. One of these islands later become Ragunna.
The refugees are of vastly different backgrounds, cultures, ideologies.
Due to relentless disasters and geological distance, the nation remains isolated from the rest of the world for many years.

The rulers of Rinascita gather in Fagaceae Peninsula for secret councils, and carve Oracles in the stone and trees.

title: Rinascita/History
content:
The rulers of Rinascita gather in Fagaceae Peninsula for secret councils, and carve Oracles in the stone and trees.



To the people, there exists not one but two divinities in the land, one ruling the skies, the Sentinel Imperator, and the other ruling the seas, the Threnodian Leviathan. These two are eternally at odds with each other, and the people wage wars against each other over their different faiths.
The Fisalia Family lays the deep-sea faith foundation of the Order as a means of securing the stability of their family's power over Ragunna. However, they are defeated in a war between them and another faction, and they are driven out. Thessaleo Fells is their domain, and the Porto-Veno Castle belongs to them.

title: Rinascita/History
content:
The Dark Tide ravages a great part of Rinascita. To save Ragunna, Imperator splits off portions of Their own power. However, this weakens the Sentinel, allowing the Threnodian to corrupt and merge with Their body, becoming a single hippocampus-like entity.
One portion of Imperator's power is sealed within Tyrvine, the sword later used to select their Resonator.
The other portion is the Remnant Spark, entrusted to Napoli II, the first Primus of the Order of the Deep. This is in the form of a lantern, which grants him the power to strengthen Echoes to fight Tacet Discord as well as purify the Dark Tide.
The ruins of ancient Ragunna are located beneath the sea of clouds in Nimbus Sanctum, with the exception of its highest spire, which is now the Atrium of Reflections.

title: Rinascita/History
content:
Upon reaching the end of the Dark Tide in his pilgrimage, Napoli II discovers the true nature of the Threnodian. However, the Sentinel's power fails to shield him from its influence, and although he physically survives, his soul does not. While the two Divinities fight for dominance in their shared form, he commits many misdeeds against his own people.
Shortly after the Dark Tide ends, he arranges a private meeting with the head of the Fisalia family. He entrusts them with the truth as well as Tyrvine before asking them to kill him.
According to an ancient tablet, he tells his believers that the Sentinel, once whole, has been rent by warring beliefs, and the Dark Tide is born from Their wounds- however, a Blessed Maiden will become the 'Enlightened One', and the Divinity will return to its true form, and Rinascita will then be free of suffering.

title: Rinascita/History
content:
Following Napoli II's death, the Order of the Deep elects a new Primus, and the spread of the faith surpasses previous reach. However, a dark mist corrupts their doctrine and changes everything regarding the Sentinel, including its statues, anecdotes, and proverbs.
Only the Fisalia Family heads and the forebearers of the Ark know the true appearance of the Sentinel.

The Fisalia family loses control over the Order of the Deep, and members begin experiencing strange nightmares involving a shadow of a giant fish beneath the sea. Many members leave the family, becoming devout believers of the Order, or moving to the seaport to distance themselves from other forces.

title: Rinascita/History
content:
The original tradition of the Pilgrim's Sail is established as an honorable act of devotion to the Sentinel. All who embark on the journey are devout, but it is said that only those blessed by the Sentinel return with the promised glory and honor. Historically, the number of survivors is vanishingly small.
Due to the high cost of the pilgrimages, the Order places a heavy tax on the commoners.

In order to destroy Leviathan, Imperator enacts a plan involving the creation of an entity known as "Fleurdelys", who will exist as a shared artificial Resonator, as well as a search for a Blessed Maiden, a Resonator of Their own.
The plan, if successful, will violate the fundamental law that entities such as Sentinels and Threnodians can only have one Resonator, and result in the destruction of Imperator, Leviathan, and Fleurdelys.

title: Rinascita/History
content: Following the Dark Tide, Septimont chooses to follow a different path than Ragunna, rejecting the Sentinel and instead championing human strength.

title: Rinascita/History
content: The Riccioli Islands maintain independence from the governance of the Order of the Deep throughout the years, and continue to preserve the customs from the Age of a Thousand Islands.

title: Rinascita/History
content:
After centuries of failure, Leviathan succeeds in the creation of Cartethyia through Imperator's return pod.
Leviathan plants Cartethyia with a human family in Egla Town, falsifying their memories of her being their biological daughter.
One of Leviathan's other failures, Mya, is created during the same time period. She is also raised by humans in Ragunna.
Promising an elixir that can grant any wish, the previous head of the Fisalia family oversees the trials to find the Blessed Maiden, who will become Imperator's Resonator.
Candidates to become the Maiden attempt to resonate with Tyrvine while Overclocking. Since this is a dangerous process, Imperator tries to minimize the deaths by splitting the excess energy resulting from Overclocking. This energy takes the form of memory fragments scattered within Avinoleum.

title: Rinascita/History
content:
The Montelli Family plays an instrumental role in charting trade routes that connect Ragunna, as well as Rinascita, to the wider world. As the island opens it maritime routes, the family rises to prominence, amassing great wealth and influence. They build the Averardo Vault to store their wealth.
Ships laden with their spices and minerals sails across the world, and in return, foreign treasures and wealth flows back to Rinascita.
The Montelli Family also takes the lead in introducing and developing Reserved Terminals across Ragunna, securing the Order's approval to develop in secrecy, offering guarantees of safety and hefty tax payment in exchange.
Carlotta is adopted by Francesco Montelli and becomes the Montelli Family's Executor.

title: Rinascita/History
content:
Carlotta is adopted by Francesco Montelli and becomes the Montelli Family's Executor.



A faction within the Fisalia Family finds the Montelli Family's actions to be a direct affront to Imperator's teachings, and begin opposing them through various means.
On one rainy night, the Fisalia Family raids the Montelli headquarters, costing many lives.
10 years after this event, Carlotta finds and executes the man responsible for orchestrating the raid.

Fenrico attends the Order's seminary as a student, and spoke passionately there of an ideal, dream world.

title: Rinascita/History
content:
~20 years before LD — Leviathan attempts to use Mya (who has moved to Septimont to become a Gladiator) to find Septimont's Central Hub and corrupt the Beacon system. Mya commits suicide by stabbing herself and jumping into the sea in order to hinder Leviathan's plans.
Mya's body is pulled from the sea by Julia Silva and given to Cristoforo. He and the Fractsidus study Mya in Septimont's sewer system for the next 20 years to gain insights into Leviathan's powers.
20 years before LD — Cartethyia unknowingly leads Ragunna as a false Blessed Maiden and Sentinel Resonator, and Leviathan feeds off of the people's worship of her. This eventually culminates in the Second Dark Tide on the day that Cartethyia was to be crowned as the Enlightened One, and appointed with her holy name, Fleurdelys. The Dark Tide erupts in the Avinoleum, which was originally located on the islands of Beohr Waters. The Second Dark Tide is stopped by Fleurdelys, who chooses to oppose the Threnodian.
Fleurdelys splits Avinoleum from the island and raises it into the sky to isolate the Dark Tide's spread.
Cantarella resonates with Tyrvine soon after the rise of Avinoleum to become the true Blessed Maiden. Imperator intends for her to accept the power of the Second Awakening, which would have killed Imperator, Leviathan, and Fleurdelys, as a Sentinel is only allowed to have a single resonator at a time, and Imperator and Leviathan have merged to become one entity. Fleurdelys' death would be collateral damage as she was the the existing Resonator for the merged entity. However, upon witnessing a vision of Fleurdelys fighting against Leviathan, Cantarella refused to accept the power, splitting it from herself and returning it to Imperator, who used the boost in power to provide an opportunity for Fleurdelys to slay the corrupted Sentinel.
The Threnodian attempts to assimilate with Fleurdelys next, and in order to buy herself time, she splits herself into two beings. Both of them are sealed within Avinoleum.
As a result of the Dark Tide, the Order is forced to abandon their seminary, later known as the Seminary of the Forgotten, as the sea of clouds floods it, reducing it to ruins before spreading to Ragunna.
A seminary teacher and his student attempt to retrieve an artifact passed down by the sages, also referred to as a 'relic of the Ancient One'. The student alone is able to retrieve the relic, discovering that it is a sword, but does not manage to escape with it.

title: Rinascita/History
content:
20 years before LD — Fenrico leads Ragunna as Primus in the aftermath of the Dark Tide. Despite knowing Fleurdelys is the Threnodian's Resonator, he believes he must keep the truth to himself, cleanse the aftermath of the Dark Tide, and lead the people to pursue a pure and united will.
He calls himself the new Enlightened One in Fleurdelys' absence, an unprecedented title for a Primus to take.
The Order immediately restricts the festivities of the Carnevale, publicly stating they are doing so to mourn the Holy Maiden.
The practice of the Pilgrim's Sail is halted for 10 years. The tax placed on the commoners to fund the tradition is also lifted.

title: Rinascita/History
content:
The practice of the Pilgrim's Sail is halted for 10 years. The tax placed on the commoners to fund the tradition is also lifted.



20 years before LD — A group of artists and researchers unexpectedly uncover a hidden piece of the Order's history, and are hunted down in the name of preserving stability. The Montelli family rescues them by offering to lock them inside the Averardo Vault. They voluntarily choose this imprisonment, hoping that they can one day return.
Within the next 20 years, all of the prisoners die, though their Reverberations remain in vault.

~20 years before LD — Lorelei is molded by the Sentinel and commanded to restrain the clouds and prevent the Remnant Energy within from dissipating. Performing this duty, she resides in the Nimbus Sanctum.

title: Rinascita/History
content:
~20 years before LD — The Marino family helps the Order Orphanage survive the worst of the Dark Tide.
Later on, their ship is attacked by Tacet Discord while on route to New Federation, and they do not survive. Their assets are liquified to offset the costs of sunken cargo, and their child, Phoebe, is sent to live at the Order Orphanage.

<20 years before LD — A group of explorers recover an Acolyte's body from the Seminary of the Forgotten, as well as the relic, but any records on it have been lost to the Dark Tide. Upon inspection, the sword appears to have been crafted for Carnevale rituals rather than for combat, and is believed to have once belonged to a Primus.

title: Rinascita/History
content:
10 Years before LD — The last annual Carnevale is brought to ruin as a monstrous sea beast, rogue Echoes, and Tacet Discords sweep through the festival.
The Primus calls this a divine punishment, and the Carnevale is banned for the next 10 years.
This festival marks the last record of the Sentinel.

title: Rinascita/History
content:
The Primus calls this a divine punishment, and the Carnevale is banned for the next 10 years.
This festival marks the last record of the Sentinel.



~10 years before LD — Following the Carnevale, Fenrico orders the reinstatement of the tradition of the Pilgrim's Sail, now as an act of punishment for violators of doctrine rather than one of faith.
Although initially reserved for acts of blasphemy, it eventually includes even members of the Order who openly question Fenrico's decrees.
The common people call this the 'Fool's Sails', ships filled with people who committed foolish acts. By extension, those who are sent aboard the Pilgrims Sails are also called 'Fools'.
The Dragon of Dirge is taken control of by the Order, intending for it to kill those sent on the Pilgrim's Sail. To conceal the dragon's existence, the Order forbids any entry onto Penitent's End.
Brant survives the Pilgrim's Sail as a child after questioning the Sentinel's statue. He goes on to form the Troupe of Fools, building Fool's Elysium with other survivors.
Roccia is sent on the Pilgrim's Sail for performing a banned play. She is saved by Pero and taken in by the Troupe of Fools.

title: Rinascita/History
content:
Roccia is sent on the Pilgrim's Sail for performing a banned play. She is saved by Pero and taken in by the Troupe of Fools.



10 years before LD — The water level of Nimbus Sanctum begins to steadily rise, forcing the residents of Egla Town to move to the higher ground in the north.

<10 years before LD — The members of Golden Anthem, a renowned Poets Society and the cantors of the Sentinel, encounter Cristoforo in Whisperwind Haven, who leads them to a lithograph depicting Imperator's true form. They try to spread the truth, leading to their deaths upon the Pilgrim's Sail, as well as the tarnish of their reputation by the Order.
They entrust the key to their study to the Toccata family, who continue their efforts to preserve the truth. However, each member is eventually sent aboard Pilgrim's Sail, with Ciaccona being the only survivor.

Scar’s mentorship involves guiding individuals through the process, believing the key to unlocking unique and twisted abilities in those who prove worthy lies in the Tacet Discords.

title: Scar
content: Scar is a tall and slim young man with spiky white hair that is red inside and numerous scars on his face, one on his right side of his face with another cutting vertically through his left eye, as well a horizontal on his left cheek. His right eye is red and his left eye is grey. He also has golden earrings shaped like ankhs. His attire consists of a grey jumpsuit under a opened and three-collared red jacket that is unbottoned with some  blades of black knives in the pockets, a type of black battery holding another ankh-like earring kept with a long black belt across the chest and a black left arm. His pants are white with red endings kept with black belts with a silver fivel and opened black buttons, which is also flared. Apart from this, Scar also wears black gloves with red endings in the fingers and black boots with red metallic parts.

title: Scar
content: Described as a Goat Grim Reaper, as Aberrant Nightmare, Scar appears to be a extremely large and muscular wendigo-like creature with dark grey skin covered in white fur, bandaged legs and arms and a light grey skull-like head with a dark grey jaw alongside its earrings. Six bioluminescent eyes that have yellow sclera with black pupils that cover its trademark scars who are light grey. As well some small, pointy black and long black ram-like horns that have white stains with his white hair now being longer with purple ending tips alongside his fingers and endings of its jacket who are now torn as a result of empowering himself, as well more growing white fur in its arms.

title: Scar
content: Scar appears to be a charismatic, yet opportunistic and manipulative individual who is passionate about his ideals, actively seeking out individuals whom he deems worthy to join Fractsidus and undertake the transformative process with the Tacet Discord. Scar opposes Huanglong’s efforts to suppress the Tacet Discord. His idea of a new world after harrowing turmoil reflects a twisted sense of evolution. He encourages individuals, especially Rover, whom he views as a kindred black lamb, doomed to stand out unfavorably from the rest, to join Fractsidus. His smile is very wide and can be described as borderline psychopathic, matching his own description of himself.

title: Scar
content: He is also shown to be very cunning when discussing his ideals, which can be shown when Rover and Scar share their first encounter. Scar also introduces himself as a "cruel and twisted maniac". He presents himself as very honest and genuine despite capturing Yangyang in an attempt to earn Rover's trust.

title: Scar
content: Scar tells the story of Qichi Village using a “fable” about a shepherd, a flock of lambs, and a black lamb as an analogy—indicating part of his playful and creative side. He also appears to value multiple perspectives, making him a very conscientious individual. Scar seems to value banter and games, as he didn’t want the Rover to cheat without looking for answers first. However, he then states that the people who succumbed to their grief (the lambs who sacrificed the black lamb) “had it coming”. Scar also claims that he self-identifies with the black lamb, being a rebel against the shepherd who breaks the rules.

title: Scar
content:
He is a Resonator, and his Tacet Mark is located across his neck.

His Resonance ability involves teleportation and the manipulation of space, as well as the creation of Elysium, a barrier that can only break under coordinated attacks from both sides.

title: Scar
content:
When Scar was a child, his mother told him many fairy tales, described as being the only tender moments in their family, though he never believed in her versions.

According to official case files of the Qichi Village incident, the perpetrators were brought to justice and the most of the townspeople were able to be safely relocated. He is believed to be the 'big brother' mentioned by the unknown girl, and as there are no mentions of her in the files, he is believed to have taken her away.

title: Sentinel
content:
The Sentinels, also called Oracle Engines, stand at the brink of civilization and history, as guardians and guides. Their immortal existence has helped humanity through countless troubles, sharing prophecies and wisdom. As Rover embarks on a new journey after enduring the Lament, the Sentinels remain humanity's record keeper and beacon in times of disaster. They were created by the Homeland Civilization, whose Exostriders would deliver them to Solaris-3.

Sentinels are only able to resonate with one Resonator at a time, and the breaking of this law will result in both the Sentinel and its current Resonator having their frequencies rent asunder, destroying them.

The Sentinel Promeus is of unknown origin, thus far only known in the prayers of the Startorch Academy student Edwards.

English-language descriptions suggest that Ashinohara may have several Sentinels that left the Legacy Talismans in the country for safekeeping. As none have been named however, it remains possible that these Sentinels left the country after bestowing the Talismans to it.

title: Sentinel
content: Through the Homeland Civilization which they originate from, as explained by Aemeath in , the Sentinels hold advanced technology that could alter the human civilizations found on Solaris-3. As they were delivered through the Exostrider for the seeming goal of helping humanity, much of their technology consists in aiding them. However, due to how advanced their technology is, such as the Genesis Nexus and Autopuppets, it is noted by Muyu in  that Sentinel technology is a black box to humanity. Baizhi attests that the Autopuppets utilized in Xuanfang Hold that are the pinnacle of Automata Mechanics as a field for the foreseeable future, where Xiangli Yao attests that Xuanfang Hold itself is a masterpiece that doesn't require people to defend the civilians. When investigating the Autopuppets, Rover states that while they're as advanced as Lahai-Roi's machines, possibly more, no one could understand how they work.

title: Sentinel
content: Though, Sentinel Hsin states in  that technology that outpaces the current era is equally a curse as it is a blessing. This suggests that the Sentinels refrain from granting humanity their full knowledge, with Hsin stating that their technology was never meant for the mortal world as to many lives were warped through their appearance. As such, certain technology like the Cloud Shuttles were never introduced after Yuan Fortress self-destructed while the Celestials, such as Ruoyun, were restricted from revealing high-clearance knowledge.

title: Sentinel
content: Sentinels also hold what is known as a Civilization Capsule. Their exact functions are unknown, however, they contain vital legacy data concerning the Sentinels and civilization. They are capable of simulating, reconstructing and converge future possibilities, and are used by the Sentinels in guiding mankind in creating humanity's civilizations. In Xuanfang Hold, the Sanctum managed to create an entire simulated timeline which Muyu interfered with during his attempt to steal it. These specific types of technology are desired by Leviathan and the Fractsidus Overseer, Balanophora, for uncertain reasons.

title: Solaris-3
content:
Solaris-3, also known as Sol-III and Solaris, is the third planet from the sun and the setting of Wuthering Waves. In the ancient past the planet was ravaged by a series of global catastrophes known collectively as The Lament. During one of these global Laments, the planet's axis and magnetic poles shifted to dramatically change the surface climate and ecology, and in the aftermath the Etheric Sea spread over the planet.

This process also physically separated Solaris from the rest of the universe, killing civilisation's budding spaceflight capabilities in its cradle, and gave rise to the Waveworn Phenomena, a series of anomalous occurrences resulting from the destabilization of natural laws. However, thanks to the Lament, humans have gained the ability to resonate and manipulate frequencies, giving rise to Resonators.

title: Solaris-3
content:
Over the past 10,000 years, Solaris-3 has suffered five global Laments and over 350,000 regional Laments. The Tethys Institute, a facility in the Pre-Lament Civilization, enacted a plan to save humanity after the destruction of 80% of all structures and half the population in the first global Lament.

Solaris' current nations appear to have been established in the last millennia, although the current state of the Roya Frostlands and their settlement by the Roya may have been established as early as the second global Lament.

Rover likely first appeared in Solaris 10,000 years ago, just as the SkyArk Space Station was destroyed in the final moments of Solaris' envelopment by the Etheric Sea. It is possible that Rover, or other Homeland Civilization compatriots, were monitoring the planet before the onset of the Lament.

title: Solaris-3
content:
Aside from its etymology, Solaris is likely a reference to Solaris, a 1961 novel by Stanisław Lem which shares some features with the planet of Wuthering Waves.
Solaris-3 is named in a fashion similar to many classic scifi planets, using the star name (Solaris) plus a number representing the distance from said star. This differs from the naming scheme of real exoplanets such as Proxima b, where they receive lowercase letters in order of discovery.
Coincidentially, under the same convention, real-life planet Earth would also be named "Sol III".
Sol, also known as Baldur, is also the name of the Roya's god.

title: Somnoire
content:
The Somnoire is a mysterious and relatively unknown realm deemed a myth by many in Solaris-3 that is related to dreams. It can only be entered through a gateway that only appears at certain locations, guarded by the Ebony and Ivory Gatekeeper, and inhabited by other entities.

According to the Ebony Gatekeeper, the realm was created by someone the Rover knew, though the Ivory Gatekeeper claims multiple people made it.

title: Somnoire
content: Little is known about the Somnoire other than its a realm that is claimed to have all the dreams, memories, and emotions of Solaris-3 converge onto it. This causes the realm to be considered bizarre and unnatural due to being made up of humans dreams and memories, which connects to both them and all living beings who have ever lived throughout history. Thus the Somnoire holds different "sections" made up of landscapes that may not make sense in general. The Ebony Gatekeeper states that the Somnoire records everything on Solaris-3 with the Rover being a crucial component to function properly, and that the Somnoire requires real memories and experience to form these different areas.

title: Somnoire
content: These areas can be entered through doors, where the more doors you open, the deeper one goes into the "dream". However, the areas may also be altered when dangerous intrusive beings such as Scar and Dreamless invade the realm, forming chaos that causes the realm to become more mismatched and allowing Tacet Discord to appear due to the Somnoire being similar to a Tacet Field, thus becoming intrusive beings that must be defeated before the Somnoire becomes further damaged.

title: Somnoire
content: Whenever one enters the Somnoire, they become an "Onlooker" and cannot bring anything with them. However, they may manifest objects or Echoes through recorded memories, or being given enhancement items known as Metaphors and Tokens from inhabitants such as the Gatekeepers or entities known as an Illusia.  At the same time, the Onlooker may assume a different form as Rover does, who may appear as either themselves, or become a different Resonator with their skillset and abilities while enhancing such abilities within the realm. The unique space of the Somnoire may also allow an Onlooker to enter another's dreams and potentially gain an aspect of them for assistance.

title: Somnoire
content: However, the Ivory Gatekeeper explains that only the Rover may enter the Somnoire and leave it at will, as nobody else may see the anomalies or the gateways produced by the Somnoire. Having control over both Gatekeepers and the Somnoire before the Rover wiped their memories and lost this knowledge. Although it is possible for other people to enter the realm under unique circumstances, that being, a part of their consciousness becoming trapped in the realm until one of the Gatekeepers releases them. During that time, the original dreamers are incapable of dreaming until then.

title: Somnoire
content: According to "Dorothy", an inhabitant of the Somnoire, time also functions differently within the realm. Claiming that memories of the inhabitants may stems not from the past, but from the future. This may be a possible due to the Somnoire recording all of Solaris-3's inhabitants memories and dreams across history, even from the future. This may be untrue, however, seeing as Fantasies of the Thousand Gateways reveals that "Dorothy" was actually the Ebony Gatekeeper, lying so he may set up his plants for the Somnium Labyrinth expansion. Though during the incident where numerous nightmares were released proved that "Dorothy" does exist alongside others, and that the Ebony Gatekeeper was simply using her identity for himself.

title: Somnoire
content: Another facet of the realm, as revealed by the Ebony Gatekeeper, is that the Somnoire is an artificial creation that is finite. Despite having tens of millions of gateways that lead to different realms, the amount that can be held is limited. As such, during periodic schedules, the Somnoire must delete countless dreams and memoires to save space through the usage of safety filters and the Ebony Gatekeeper. Though, while it is possible to create more space by expanding the realm into Solaris-3, the consequences are disastrous as they can cause various nightmares and Tacet Discords to manifest and enter the planet, causing untold devastation that endanger the entire world unless it is stopped.

title: Somnoire
content: The nature of the Somnoire, as it is a world of dreams, also makes it impossible for anything within the Somnoire to be taken outside of it. Though recent events has shown that it is possible, with the two Gatekeepers discussing that either the Somnoire has either developed a consciousness of its own or that someone within the Somnoire possesses an ability powerful enough to shatter the boundary between dreams and reality, who are unknown to the Gatekeepers themselves. While the source is unknown, a layer within the Somnoire where certain inhabitants of the realm can create films that utilize the dreams and frequencies of the Somnoire to produce them may be the source itself.

title: Somnoire
content: It is also revealed that the entire realm was created for the possibility that a dream may hold the answer to deal with the Lament. Thus why all dreams are stored until they are reviewed and later deleted for the next dream.

title: Somnoire
content: In Ragunna City, the Rover discovers that despite the realm connecting to other dreams, the White Cat reveals that other locations, such as Rinascita, are blocked off from the Somnoire due to restrictions placed upon admin privileges and the Resonance Nexus. Only when the dream nodes are active can other locations be connected with the dreams shared in the determined area linking with the Somnoire. Though the Somnoire can be granted access from an outside force, with the White Cat claiming that Ragunna could now be accessed, with certain exceptions due to unknown energy blocking off Fagaceae Peninsula and Penitent's End, up until the Rover dealt with the obstructions and allowing Ragunna to be established properly.

title: Somnoire
content: One problem did occur however where, due to the involvement of Leviathan and it's spiritual plague in the region, caused numerous impurities to enter the Somnoire as the Threnodian has infected Rinascita's people which in turn tainted their dreams. The Ebony Gatekeeper was forced to create a gateway in Rinascita and seal the impurities behind it and the Memory Zones within.

title: Somnoire
content: During the events of Lucy’s arrival on Solaris-3, she caused the formation of a Dream Band. The Ivory Gatekeeper describes it as a manifestation of frequency in the flesh, only appearing in the Somnore under the rarest of conditions. Through it, the Dream Band and the Nightmare Tacet Discord that makes up Adam Smasher are considered two types of the same coin, being perfect inversions of one another. By harnessing the Dream Band, it can counteract the corruption spread by Adam Smasher and even damage him.

title: Somnoire
content:
Though the Dream Band shattered into three shards when it should be whole, requiring the pieces to be gathered and made whole again while protected from Adam Smasher’s forces who wished to prevent the shards union. Upon reuniting as one, it allowed the embodiment of Lucy’s happiness, David, to reappear again and counter Adam Smasher. Upon Adam Smasher’s defeat, the damage he wrought retracted and vanished away.

The Dream Band is considered to be very rare, as even the Ivory Gatekeeper never saw one before up until the events of Lucy's arrival.

title: Somnoire
content: At times the Somnoire may be invaded by outside forces, be it those who are alive or dead.  While it is unknown how they appear within the Somnoire, intrusive beings such as Scar or Dreamless may also cause interference in the Somnoire, which in turn mixes dreamscapes together. The result being that certain people may look at the same item/entity at the same time, yet each see something else in their perspective.  These anomalies in Somnoire are considered disruptive to the usual laws and order of the realm's space.

title: Somnoire
content: Depending on the danger, this may allow Tacet Discords to form and potentially escape the Somnoire, and depending on the situation - transformed and becoming Phantom or Nightmare variants. One which has occurred in Ragunna, as an unknown threat - identified later as the Threnodian Leviathan - that resides somewhere, even after clearing the dream nodes, with the White Cat claiming that this hidden force is subconsciously manipulating people's dreams in Ragunna. This has caused the release of the Nightmare variants to now exist across different areas in Ragunna. The Ebony Gatekeeper also aiding in maintaining and preventing what this hidden force, as he calls it, a "spiritual plague", from infecting the rest of the Somnoire with the Rover's assistance.

title: Somnoire
content: Another example of intrusions comes from those who have perished. After the halt of the Somnoire Expansion, the dreams of those who died from the Black Shores began gathering and took the form of Fallacy of No Return, which endangered the realm and required the Shorekeepers' assistance. Another took the form of an incident where the Ivory Gatekeeper accidentally opened a gate which unleashing deadly nightmares, nightmares that only existed due to the interference of Leviathan itself who had placed a spiritual plague on Rinascita's people.

title: Somnoire
content: Depending on the circumstances, the Somnoire could be altered by outside forces. During Chromatic Fantasy, a gateway that acts as both the entrance and exit to the Somnore appeared in Lahai-Roi, except it became linked with Honami City and mixed them together, which forced Namipon to aid in the events. Namipon explains that this was caused by the Left Behind in Honami City, whose dreams manifested in a corner of Lahai-Roi which caused fantasy and reality to overlap into a chaotic disorder within the Somnoire which Namipon calls “Lost Dreams”.

title: Somnoire
content: However, Namipon claims the Left Behind alone couldn’t have caused this with “Dorothy” confirming this as she reveals that a frequency not of Solaris-3 found it’s way into the Somnoire somehow, triggering the realm’s defense mechanisms without the Gatekeepers noticing. This resulted in the dreamscape layers piling atop one another and “accidently” bridging the Left Behind’s dreams with Lahai-Roi, with the breach unable to be patched anytime soon but was stabilized thanks to Rover’s assistance.

title: Somnoire
content: This intrusion however would lead to the events of At Dream's Edge. The incident was unintentionally caused by Lucy, who’s dream connected with the Somnoire despite being from another reality altogether and caused the birth of, Rebecca, Adam Smasher, the Somnoire: Night City, and the Dream Band to appear. This formed a gateway connecting Solaris-3 and Lucy's native universe that remained in the deepest layer of the Somnoire. The Ivory Gatekeeper states the fact that two universes connecting through the Somnoire was a first for him.

title: Somnoire
content: The fallout of Lucy's arrival caused a gateway within the Somnore to materialize at Startorch Academy, which began contaminating both the surrounding area through an abnormal frequency at the academy and the Somnoire itself, forcing the Ebony Gatekeeper to handle the contaminated sectors in the background. Similar to the Ebony Gatekeeper’s plans, the Ivory Gatekeeper states if the gateway in Lahai-Roi were allowed to spread the abnormal frequencies, everyone would be pulled into the Somnoire and never awaken again. Lucy's arrival also caused unique Nightmare Tacet Discords to form from her fears who began an invasion across reality and would persist unless Lucy overcame her past traumas or continue spreading themselves and the contamination without stop. After the events in Adam Smasher’s defeat, the source of the contamination, Lucy could return back to her native universe which would stabilize the two worlds at the price of the events fading away like a dream with none, not even Lucy, recalling the adventure beyond a few like Rover. The Ivory Gatekeeper claimed Lucy could have potentially stayed in the Somnoire through an unknown method, but she refused, however and returned home.

title: Somnoire
content: During the events of Lucy's arrival in At Dream's Edge, a unique form of Nightmare Tacet Discords manifested in the Somnoire that came to be from Lucy's fears. Being more self-aware and intelligence, they were led by the Nightmare Tacet Discord Adam Smasher, who sought to haunt Lucy and spread his contamination across Lahai-Roi alongside the Somnoire through assimilation.

title: Somnoire
content: They were able to manifest outside the Somnoire and invade reality, which Abby states should be impossible as there was no gateway to allow their exit. Due to their unique frequencies, attacks that didn’t come from Lucy, Rebecca, and Rover’s power of Seperation were ineffective towards them, as Lynae noted when attacking them and could do little damage. Moryne states that their frequencies can somehow weaken and neutralize Lahai-Roi’s weapons’ attacks, thus the requirement to study Lucy and Rebecca’s weapon frequency to apply onto the region’s weapons.

title: Somnoire
content:
Though willing to harm others, they were primarily targeting Lucy. This is due to Adam Smasher’s connection to her as one born of her fears of his original-self, and sought to target her weakness in what’s suggested to be an attempt to ensure she never mentally recovered from her fears of the original as he could only exist so long as she never moves past her nightmares. Thus the requirement of the Dream Band, which could counteract his powers. Though the Ivory Gatekeeper admitted that as a last resort, killing Lucy would also help as it would cause the numerous Nightmare TD’s to vanish without their source. This is primarily because Adam Smasher was considered immortal and invulnerable so long as Lucy continued to fear him.

Upon his defeat, the damage wrought by him and his forced cleared away with the contamination returning to normal.

title: Somnoire
content: A strange layer within the Somnoire from the deeper layers which has only recently opened where a set amount of inhabitants, a crew of seven, have made "films" based on the dreams and frequencies within the Somnoire. These films utilize familiar faces which may in turn give them similar personalities based on those they were based on. The source and potential hosts of the layer is also powerful enough to ensure none but those invited can enter. Being powerful enough to manifest an invitation into the real world, breaking the boundary of dreams and reality itself.

title: Somnoire
content: The Rover is allowed entry and is the only one that can be accepted within it, denying even the Ivory and Ebony Gatekeepers themselves. In turn, the Rover can view but also interact within the observed films while gaining newly enhanced abilities within while working alongside the "actors" of the film itself during the interaction.

title: Somnoire
content:
The Somnoire is home to certain beings which include:
Illusia: The primary inhabitants are known as Illusias.  They are described as virtual entities, a conglomeration of the countless consciousnesses within the Gate. They are stated by the Ebony Gatekeeper to be those who dream, though don't truly exist and have formed due to the gate that leads into the realm. They may give Tokens and other items to those who enter the realm.
Dreamers: Those who dream and thus are recorded by the Somnoire. Onlookers who enter may find themselves observe another person's dream, allowing them to gain the aid of said dreamer by having an aspect of them, or Metaphor as it's called, for support. During the expansion of the Somnoire, the Rover could enter these dreams while said Dreamers were more aware due to a piece of their original-selves becoming trapped in the Somnoire until they were released.
Gatekeepers: The two Gatekeepers that keep watch over the Somnoire. While the role of the Ivory Gatekeeper remains unknown, the Ebony Gatekeeper's duty is to erase useless dreams that won't help in vanquishing the Lament. They both, however, are tasked with protecting the realm from disruptive elements known to enter the Somnoire, as per their duty, ensuring the stability of its dream capacity. As such, both hold certain control over the Somnoire for their duties.
Tacet Discords: Due to the Somnoire containing traits similar to the Tacet Fields, Tacet Discords are capable of being born in the Somnoire. Though they are considered dangerous elements in the realm that shouldn't belong and are capable of exiting it if a gateway exists, which may cause a TD Outbreak.
Dorothy and friends: An unknown figure who posed as "Cosmo", claims that she and her friends reside in the Somnoire itself.  However, she also states that at some point they had lived in Solaris-3 before entering through the Gate like Rover had, though refused to explain further. Later revealed to be the Ebony Gatekeeper himself, tricking the Rover for his plans during "When the Night Knocks", only to be rebutted when it was just him taking her form. Unlike her friends, Dorothy is also capable of leaving the Somnoire, but only for small periods before it becomes deadly while her friends are incapable of leaving. They claim to know the Rover with Dorothy having a relationship with the Ebony Gatekeeper, implied to be friendly as he aids her at times.  She also has a hidden location to play in.
“Dorothy”: Despite looking exactly like the original Dorothy, numerous comments coming from her suggest she either looks like the original or takes over Dorothy’s body. She claims to know Rover but is cryptic about it and states she was created by someone she called "Mom", who she has not seen in a while.
Solaris Film Festival Crew and Guests: Other inhabitants of the Somnoire, those who come from a layer that make films, utilizing the memories and frequencies of the Somnoire itself to create them. The Rover can interact within these films, made by about seven people which can be seen by other inhabitants within other layers of the Somnoire.
D: One of the visitors and viewers of the films made in the Somnoire.

title: Sonoro Sphere
content:
Sonoro Spheres, "Field of Sound," are instances in Wuthering Waves.

Completing the challenges within Sonoro Spheres rewards various items and materials such as Weapon and Skill Materials, Weapon & Skill Materials, Union EXP, Intimacy, and Shell Credits in return for some Waveplate.

title: Sonoro Sphere
content: Sonoro Spheres are spaces of dense abundant Remnant Energy, capable of preserving transdimensional information. They are important sources of information for humanity to understand the history and civilization of The Lament, and are a part of the field of Ecoacoustic research. While generally a naturally occurring phenomenon, artificial Sonoro Spheres exist, such as the Simulation Training that Midnight Rangers use, with the Nimbus Sanctum being a unique Sonoro Sphere that can be interacted in the physical plane.

title: Sonoro Sphere
content:
However, upon entering a Sonoro Sphere, information may become distorted and it becomes difficult to remove the interference from the original contents. There is also the possibility that when recording information, if the conditions are met, a person dying within the vicinity of the Sonoro Sphere will cause the copy of the original to be fully self-aware instead of being a recorded illusion. There is risk then of the version trapped within to become infected with maligned frequencies, such as  Pascar who had been warped into a Tacet Discord from corruption. The Lament itself could also consume and imprison locations, such as Honami City, which has since become the Chronorift Metropolis.

Sonance Caskets are the product of the natural decay and collapse of Sonoro Spheres, and thus hold high archaeological value.

The Shorekeeper is a Remnant Creature made up of Sonoro Spheres herself.

title: Sonoro Sphere
content:
The Shorekeeper is a Remnant Creature made up of Sonoro Spheres herself.



Among natural and artificial occurring Sonoro Sphere, there are also Resonators who wield the ability to create a Sonoro Sphere themselves. As they are creating the Sonoro Sphere through their Resonance Ability, the Sonoro Sphere will form and reflect under the user's own traits, ideals, and beliefs. One example would be the Fractsidus Overseer Phrolova who has access to a mysterious Sonoro Sphere known as "The Beyond" in which all decaying frequencies converge and in which she summons the powerful Tacet Discord Hecate from but also created the Lost Beyond for her lost home. Others such as Cristoforo and Ciaccona also wield their own Sonoro's with their own unique effects and abilities. It's possible for a Resonator to have their Sonoro Sphere exist for a certain lenth of time, as seen by the Forever Fest created by Cobb Copo lasting for years, or Cristoforo entrapping Septimont for an unknown amount of time. However, this varies as eventually they will fade away in due time alongside anything within it.

title: Sonoro Sphere
content: At the same time, certain Sonoro Spheres can be formed from a rise in emotions from a collective group. Similar to Resonators creating Sonoro Spheres, these specific Sonoro's can take form and shape by the unconscious thoughts that create the space itself. The Academy's Dark Side and the Sea of Ghosts of the Fisalia Family were both created by unconscious thoughts, making a reflective plane in the area they are created in with their own rules that must be followed. While not impossible to confine and shape them, it's difficult where these Sonoro Sphere's are usually permanent in duration unless one deals with the emotions that linger and gave birth to these areas.

title: Startorch Academy
content:
Startorch Academy is a multinational school built by the Spacetrek Collective specifically for Resonators in Lahai-Roi.

It is known to contain the Exo Genesis Labs, Voidwatch Tower, Tactical Proving Grounds, and Simulator Cockpit. Its name comes from the phrase "Let Knowledge Be Your Guiding Star, Raise High the Torch of Tomorrow".

All students (except Synchronists admitted to Rabelle College) begin with a cross-disciplinary curriculum, which covers foundational sciences, humanities, and essential survival skills for life in Lahai-Roi. Students' specialized department placement is determined at the end of Year 2, based on their stated interest and academic performance.

title: Startorch Academy
content: The Startorch Academy dorms offer every student their own private space to relax and recharge. Every space in the building is thoughtfully designed to meet a variety of needs. The resting area creates a calming environment that helps even insomniacs rest with ease. Soundproofed walls minimise noise complaints, ensuring peace of mind. Students are also free to rearrange or decorate their rooms as they like - so long as it's within school regulations.

title: Startorch Academy
content: Auto-Clean Pods are the Academy's intelligent modules that offer highly efficient, fully automated laundromat services that integrate garment cleaning with nano-repair technology. It automatically identifies fabric types and applies tailored care programs, effectively repairing damage and extending garment lifespan. The academy encourages faculty and students to make active use of this facility.

title: Startorch Academy
content: UNICODE is the Academy's uniform store, where students and staff visit for bespoke uniform tailoring services. The store's intelligent fitting systems ensure each uniform is measured and tailored to the customer. The measurement data is encrypted and accessible only with authorisation, ensuring full protection of customer privacy.

title: Startorch Academy
content: RPGs are modular entertainment units found around the residential quarter of the Academy where the "tenth art" is on full display. According to Rabelle College studies, when combined with Frequency Modulation technologies, video games can help students relieve stress, regulate mood, and restore cognitive wellbeing. The Academy encourages students to balance their academic effort with entertainment to achieve better results.

title: Startorch Academy

title: Stellar Matrices
content:
Stellar Matrices are, based on the computational protocols of the Black Shores' Tethys System, a data package format that functions similarly to a highly compressed file. They have the capacity to store immense amounts of information and can even simulate a Lament.

Certain individuals can access these matrices under specific circumstances, making them an integral part of the Tethys System's operational framework.

title: Stellar Matrices
content: The first member to define a Stellar Matrix noted that standards of observing and evaluating one are similar to the astronomical standards of Solaris-3. Properly functioning Stellar Matrices are projected into the subterranean galaxy of the Black Shores, allowing members to study, observe, and Modulate them. However, as these celestial bodies collide, merge, and collapse, the code evolves through countless iterations. Occasionally, this process spawns errant code within some Stellar Matrices. To avoid contamination, the Black Shores contains these Stellar Matrices in special Tacetite vessels in the Error Cell. The Error Cell then analyzes the aberrant data, deploying specialized probes to isolate the rogue code segments.

title: Stellar Matrices
content: The Modulation Hall is where "Modulator" of the past and people of the present observe and guide the course of stars in the vast underground sky. Through here all beings are reborn as stars, which, in turn, reflect brief moments of reality. With the power of the Tethys System, Star Matrices brought to this place can reveal glimpses of the past, whether of destruction or renewal.

title: Stellar Matrices
content: The Data Torrent connecting all the Nexus on this planet continuously transfers information about abnormal fluctuations caused by the Lament and Waveworn back to the Stellar Matrix. The Stellar Matrix then constructs models to predict the location and time of the next Lament.

title: Stellar Matrices
content:
A Necrostar is a type of Stellar Matrix that swallows the faulty data in its wake, a black hole where forsaken Stellar Matrices find their end. Even the newfound science of Tacetite could not provide explanations for its fundamental nature, as all are subject to the gravity within it. A Necrostar marks the beginning and the end of destruction.

Necrostars were once known as "black holes" in ancient astronomy. All of Solaris-3's data is converted into stars for observation by the Tethys System, while the discarded data is cast into the Necrostar. Due to its nature, Necrostar's frequencies are incredibly complex.

title: Tacet Discord
content:
Tacet Discords (abbreviated as TDs) are sentient beings formed by the residual chaotic frequency energy under the Waveworn Phenomenon with ever-changing, amorphous forms. They possess , also known by the academic community as  and instinctively feed on other frequencies to maintain stability and evolve.

These creatures mimic the abilities, shapes, and behaviors of others and are influenced by the types of frequency they consume.

title: Tacet Discord
content:
Ever since the emergence of the Waveworn Phenomenon, humanity has been fixated on researching the enigma known as the Tacet Discords.

These entities are seen as sources of destruction and embodiments of chaotic energy. Despite extensive study, our understanding remains incomplete due to a lack of information on their composition.

As time passes, this gap in knowledge will only widen, resulting in the gradual decay and eventual annihilation of these discords. To sustain itself, the Tacet Discords possess an instinctual drive to consume and merge with other frequencies, in a constant battle to maintain its existence.

title: Tacet Discord
content:
Upon its demise, the frequencies of a Tacet Discord will not immediately vanish. Instead, they will slowly decay over time, allowing for their capture and utilization.

Once enough frequencies have been stored, they can be harnessed to replicate the abilities of the original Tacet Discord.

This remaining energy, capable of emulating the defeated entity's power, is known as an Echo - a valuable asset that must be carefully collected and preserved in our laboratory archives.
