title: Tacet Field
content:
Tacet Fields are easily identifiable locations, featuring a sky of inverted seas and a deep cross-shaped Tacet Mark on the ground. Meanwhile, Paradimensional Tacet Fields are accessed through a Tacet Mark shaped door way that sit diagonally from the ground.

The convergence of the Etheric Sea results in the formation of new Tacet Fields, which initially go through a Dormant period, during which the area is relatively safe. A faster formation generally results in a longer Dormant period, as well as stronger Tacet Discords.

title: Tacet Field
content:
A former researcher from Huaxu Academy and childhood friend of Xiangli Yao, Pascar identified the special frequency of the Tacet Field, and developed a prototype detector that can predict where they are forming. After Pascar and the prototype were devoured by Waveworn, his notes were recovered and the theory restored, named the 'Pascar Spectrum' theory. While the prototype has yet to be successfully recreated, the theory has gained global recognition as well as attracted the attention of the Black Shores.

As part of their efforts in researching an ancient civilization, a group of scientists exiled from the Court of Savantae performed an experiment into creating an Artificial Controllable Tacet Field.

title: Tacet Field
content: While Tacet Fields kill the plants in their environment, they are also a source of unique plants and minerals, such as Floramber that forms from the remains of the dead plants, and Erodorchids that grow on the edges of Tacet Fields.

title: Tacet Mark
content: A Tacet Mark is a symbol that appears on every Resonator's body at the time of their Awakening.

title: Tacet Mark
content:
Bearing a strong resemblance to the cross-shaped marks seen in Tacet Fields, the exact shape of a Resonator's Tacet Mark seems to be related to their Rabelle's Curve, with the exception of Jiyan, who bears a unique mark. The placement of the mark on one's body seems entirely random, however, family members can occasionally share the same placements, as demonstrated with Yangyang and Suisui.

Tacet Marks are not static feature on the body, like a scar or tattoo, but instead constantly changing in size and thrumming in relation to the amount of Resonance Energy the Resonator currently has. Upon utilizing their Resonance Liberation, a Resonator's Tacet Mark will glow.

title: Tacetite
content: In studying the Waveworn Phenomenon, scientists discovered Tacetite - a substance that can permanently hold Remnant Energy.

title: Tacetite
content:
When modified, Tacetite can become a potent energy weapon for Resonators, capable of harming the Tacet Discords.

The core modules of these weapons are charged with Energy Cores, supplements storing Tacetite Energy. Resonators are advised to perform routine maintenance on their weapons to ensure they currently are retaining charge, and experienced Resonators often preassemble and preheat Energy Cores to prevent weapon malfunctions during intense battles.

In Jinzhou, the Ministry of Development once developed Tacetite Weapons to allow non-Resonator units in the Midnight Rangers fight against Tacet Discord. However, since they did not possess Forte and prolonged exposure posed health risks, the output of the weapons was limited for safety.

The Rover carries a unique version of the Terminal that can be upgraded.

The primary function of the Terminal is to collect and record Reverberations. These Reverberations are turned into Echoes by the Terminal, which can then be directed as needed. The Data Bank module of the Terminal allows Resonators to replicate the combat abilities of these Echoes in battle. Additionally, some Echoes enable Resonators to briefly transform into the shapes of the Tacet Discords that are stored.

It also has a Utility module, with features such as Grapple, Sensor, and Levitator.

Each Terminal carries a unique Terminal ID which allows the Rover to unlock portions of the Map via Huanglong's Nexus Towers and Rinascita's Genesis Nexus.

title: Tethys System
content:
The Tethys System (also known as the "Civilization Sand Table") is the central terminal of the Black Shores. It predates the Lament. The Black Shores relies on its calculations to observe, forewarn, and solve anything related to the Lament as it can hold nearly infinite data, and is akin to a collection of Sonoro Spheres. It relies on emotions from the Lament to fuel its calculations, where Lament data is visualized as stars in the system, while discarded data is cast into the Necrostar. Only the Tethys System understands the true nature of the Lament.

It was first introduced in Rewinding Raindrops.

title: Tethys System
content: By inputting Lament frequency data-collected both manually and via beacon access-into the system, the Black Shores can issue Lament warnings for locations worldwide within a 24 to 48-hour time range. This capability is the cornerstone of the Black Shores' extensive collaborations with countries across the globe. Its coding language is extremely complex, and it is only known that its terminals take the form of various autonomous robots.

title: Tethys System
content:
Based on the computational protocols of the Tethys System, the Stellar Matrix is a data package format that functions similarly to a highly compressed file. It has the capacity to store immense amounts of information and even simulate a Lament. Certain individuals can access these matrices under specific circumstances, making them an integral part of the Tethys System's operational framework.

Properly functioning Stellar Matrices are projected into the subterranean galaxy of the Black Shores, allowing members to study and observe them. Malfunctioning matrices, however, are collected and isolated in designated areas to prevent data overflow.

The first member to define a Stellar Matrix noted that standards of observing and evaluating one are similar to the astronomical standards of Solaris-3.

Its coding language is extremely complex, and it is only known that its terminals take the form of various autonomous robots. In essence, the Tethys System is almost akin to a natural phenomenon, with an origin that remains entirely mysterious. It serves as a civilization calculator and forms the foundation upon which the Black Shores stand. The results generated by the Tethys System are projected as a starry sky within the underground of the Black Shores, made possible by multiple Anchors and underground Data Hubs. This has earned the underground region the title "City of Eternal Night".

title: The Lament
content: "The Lament" (Chinese: 悲鸣,  "lament" or "wail of sorrow") is a term used to describe a series of catastrophic mass-extinction phenomena that have affected the planet, Solaris-3, and is one of the primary driving narratives in Wuthering Waves. It serves as the general classification for all major disaster trends and Waveworn Phenomena observed on the planet. Over the past 10,000 years, five global Lament events and more than 300,000 regional instances have been recorded, indicating a recurring and persistent pattern of large-scale disruption. These events have led to the emergence of individuals known as Resonators—those who have adapted to, or been shaped by, the residual energy of the Lament.

title: The Lament
content:
The Black Shores is a covert organization responsible for safeguarding humanity and overseeing the surveillance and mitigation of the Lament through the Tethys System. They have developed a predictive system for Lament activity and have established cooperative partnerships with nations across Solaris-3. Resonance Beacons have been deployed to continuously monitor the Lament, enabling real-time data collection. Additionally, the organization utilizes monitoring registers positioned worldwide to track and analyze Sentinels - entities that serve as guardians of the remaining civilization.

The Fractsidus aims to accelerate the next instance of the Lament - dubbed as the "True Lament" - by resurrecting the Threnodians, formidable creatures born from the Laments, with the power to destroy the human spirit and feed off of their collapsed will.

title: The Lament
content: As revealed in Chapter I: Act VIII - To the Shore's End, The Lament disrupts the fundamental laws of physics, with gravity remaining the only consistent force. This destabilization causes reality to fracture unpredictably, giving rise to anomalies that affect both the natural world and human infrastructure. These phenomena range from warped terrains to time-displaced echoes of past lives, driven by accumulated Remnant Energy—data-like residues of memory and emotion.

title: The Lament
content:
During the quest, Legacy of the Lasting Night, the emotional manifestation of the Lament involves psychological disruptions in affected individuals. It induces symptoms such as obsessive behavior, hallucinations, and emotional instability—particularly despair, grief, and fixation on past traumas. These effects are believed to stem from Remnant Energy interacting with human consciousness, creating feedback loops of unresolved emotion.

Following the onset of the Lament, all forms of exploration beyond Solaris-3 were suspended. The destabilization of physical laws—leaving gravity as the only constant—rendered long-range travel and advanced technologies unreliable. Interstellar expansion, once a symbol of human ambition, came to a complete halt as foundational systems failed under unpredictable conditions.

title: The Lament
content: Despite these limitations, certain scholars and explorers continued their research, driven by lingering curiosity and a desire to return to the skies. While official efforts ceased, isolated attempts persist in hopes of understanding the Lament’s origins and reclaiming what was lost.

title: The Lament
content: During the exploration across Honami City in the questline, Stagnant Dawn on Wastelands, observation shows how the Lament caused a mass chaotic effect across Honami City's reality. Space itself had been sliced through the effects of the Iridglow, capable of cutting through and confusing space, making it difficult to reach the source of it, Neon Tower, where the Lament resides. Through Chisa and Sumika’s time in the city, they explain that the Lament had consumed the entire location (starting from Neon Tower) and entrapped the city in a mass Sonoro Sphere which subjected the region onto a unusual time loop. Time itself has also been affected greatly where those inside experience a time dilation; months could pass within the interior while years pass outside of it.  Over time, the Lament is stated to have weakened and is no longer the real thing, it's power fading, though Chisa attests that it's still dangerous. More so when the Fractsidus begun experimenting on the land since the space in Honami City was considered to be like shattered glass, where anything too forceful could make it collapse.

title: The Lament
content: While Honami City had been originally sealed, through the combination of Sumika cracking it open by sending out a message from the gathered Longings, it causes the restraints around the Sonoro to weaken, allowing the Black Shores and Abby to slowly cause the connection between the city and the outside world to become stronger. After the defeat of the Chronorift Yakujin, the loops ended with the Black Shores making a full connection with the city, allowing time flow to stabilize within the Sonoro itself. Though hazard zones and dangers do still remain in spite of the situation being settled.

title: The Lament
content: When reading Sumika's Notes, who catalogued some of the effects the Lament had on Honami, she wrote down that everything two-dimensional, three dimensional, is equally sliced by the Lament like it does with people, buildings, and everything else within the space, where Namipon adds their own existence was torn apart from it. Plants themselves aren’t bound by the “reset” though, unaffected by the way time moves forward and backward within the fixed range of the temporal loops. Food became compressed Remnant Energy with living things no longer feeling hunger. One fortunate consequence of the unusual timeflow in Honami City is that in spite of Chisa being in danger of Overclocking, the Sonoro Sphere stalled Chisa’s condition and prevented her from endangering herself. Neon Tower, as it is the source and center of the Lament in Honami City, and is the one place where if the right path is found, can allow one to escape the city. To reach the source of it, however, one needs filtered Longings to make way or risk finding themself lost from the rearranged space where time moves slower the closer one gets to the tower. This is because time is completely out of sync, causing Sumika to see time fragments of her past itself. Only through the Longings can one find the right path as they resonate with the source of the Lament.

title: The Lament
content: While the Lament cannot be controlled or manipulated in normal circumstances, Stranger Things in Honami shows how the Left Behind known as Miki’s father managed to utilize the Lament’s powers due to being devoured and becoming a part of the phenomenon. Namipon explains that Longings are frequencies that persist within the Lament, not disappearing even when devoured, which could in turn affect the Lament’s residual power in Honami if the Longings are strong enough. Though Miki’s father was unable to properly control the power of the Lament, which in turn twisted the wishes and was only stopped when he found satisfaction that Shashou Cafe was doing alright.

title: The Lament
content:
The third storyline reveals that gravity was the one law that was unaltered.
The term "The Lament" is officially translated across multiple languages with words that convey cries, screams, or expressions of mourning, emphasizing its identity as both a world-ending catastrophe and a resonant sound event. In Simplified and Traditional Chinese, it appears as 悲鸣 / 悲鳴; in Japanese, as 悲鳴 (himei); in Korean, as 비명 (bimyeong); in French, as La Lamentation; in German, as Lamento; and in Spanish, as Lamento. This linguistic consistency aligns with Wuthering Waves’ broader use of sound-centric terminology underscoring a thematic framework where sonic and emotional frequencies shape the metaphysics of the world.
The Shorekeeper describes the Lament as “the death knell for humanity, leaving billions upon billions of lives lost to its wail.” The phrase death knell refers not only to a metaphorical warning of imminent demise, but also to an actual tolling of a bell traditionally used to signal death in many cultures.

title: The Moon
content: The Moon is a Waveworn Phenomenon in the sky of Solaris-3, likely some kind of reflection of the Etheric Sea akin to Retroact Rain's ability to conjure up the memories of those caught in it. In this sense, the Moon that can be observed on Solaris today is likely a sort of mass-civilisational memory passed from generation to generation, explaining why its appearance is different from culture to culture and why it never appears during the day.

title: The Moon
content: The exact history of the Moon remains unclear. Its appearance in all cultures on Solaris demonstrates that at one point, the Moon was a real physical object orbiting the planet. While its destruction is a fact, when exactly this occurred is not clear, although presumably the inhabitants of Solaris would not be able to confirm this destruction if it occurred after the fall of SkyArk Space Station and the envelopment of the Etheric Sea. Events in Dreaming Deep, which may or may not be tales based on reality, imply that the Moon once visible from the surface was artificially placed in orbit. Some aspects of Jinzhou culture and the dual moons seen in the Sanguis Plateaus and Roya Frostlands suggest that Solaris may have even had two moons at one point.

title: The Moon
content:
The Moon plays an important role in many cultures in Solaris. Both Jinzhou and Septimont use the moon's reflection for fortune-telling, while the Moon-Chasing Festival of Huanglong remains one of its most important traditional festivals. The Sentinel Hsin is also related to the moon, being given the title "Moon Fox."

The moon both visible and visited during At Dream's Edge is not Solaris' moon, and instead is a Somnoire-induced recreation of Earth's moon from Lucy's memories of the  universe.

title: The White Tower
content: The White Tower is a Threnodian sealed deep within the Somnoire. Little is known about its nature and true origins, beyond what is relayed in the lore of Dreaming Deep.

title: The White Tower
content: Described as a Threnodian that was instinctually drawn to the "brilliance" of an ancient civilization on Solaris-3 from afar, it brought upon this society's total destruction, leading to the Ivory Gatekeeper and Ebony Gatekeeper taking initiative to preserve the remnants of their civilization within the Somnoire. The White Tower would notice this, and take to chasing after their preserved remains. To stop its incessant destruction, the Gatekeepers worked together to seal the White Tower in the Somnoire by splitting it into a myriad of layers across dream realms, leaving the White Tower stranded at the bottom of its deepest layer.

title: The White Tower
content: The White Tower would later make attempts to stir from the depths of its prison. However, this would be countered by the emergence of D- who formed either as a residual frequency of the Threnodian in opposition to it that severed itself and became influenced by human emotion, or as a result of a manifestation of the civilization's will itself. D began reconstituting her memories and records through the creation of films, while also battling the Threnodian's nightmare creations.

title: The White Tower
content: D, from Dreaming Deep, is theorized to be a manifestation of it.

title: The White Tower
content: The White Tower is strongly implied to be the second known alien Threnodian, similar to Aleph-1. Much like the latter, it became attracted to Solaris-3 from the abyss of space, and attempted to wreak mass destruction upon its arrival. Both were sealed for centuries by forces that arose in opposition, such as the twin Gatekeepers of the Somnoire in the case of the White Tower, and the Exostrider in Aleph-1's case.

title: Threnodian
content:
Threnodians are formidable creatures born from the Laments, with the power to destroy human spirit and feed off of their collapsed will.

If civilizations represent mankind's collective will, they are the embodiment of the hidden fears and inner turmoil of humanity, manifesting as destructive disasters known as Tacet Discord that spread across different parts of the world.

title: Threnodian
content: Threnodians are a reflection of the collective fears of humanity condensed into physical form, born from the dark side of collective consciousnesses. Each Threnodian embodies a certain fear of struggle, which has a deep connection to the area that faces them, such as Ovathrax, the Threnodian of War, in Jinzhou, a land that has been a battleground for centuries.

title: Threnodian
content:
Threnodians are incredibly powerful creatures, and are capable of vastly strengthening the effects of Waveworn Phenomenon on their surrounding environment. Just as a Sentinel has their own appointed Resonator whom they have resonated with, so too do Threnodians. However, the exact process of becoming a Threnodian's Resonator, and whether all Threnodians are capable of obtaining a Resonator, is not known—as Leviathan only gained this ability after its assimilation with the Sentinel Imperator, and Aleph-1's Resonator was artificially induced.

A single Threnodian's revival is never an independent occurrence, as they can sense each other through some form of telepathic link and can trigger catastrophic events across Solaris-3.

title: Threnodian
content: After fusing with Leviathan, Sentinel Imperator gained knowledge that as long as there is human civilization, Threnodians will always exist, and Threnodians cannot be truly killed as even Leviathan itself does not know the means to do it. The only way to defeat a Threnodian is to shackle it to a Resonator. Aalto explains that due to their nature as shadows of civilization, they are both formless and immortal, thus cannot entirely be erased. Therefore, sealing it inside the Resonator's body is the next best method in defeating a Threnodian by giving them form. This was proven to be true as Leviathan was successfully sealed. For now, the threat of Threnodian is over in Rinascita and it will take some time before a new Threnodian will appear to replace the sealed Leviathan.

title: Threnodian
content:
Due to their unique nature, Cristoforo reveals that a Threnodian’s power and essence is one and the same, and he claims that if Leviathan were to possess Abby through the Dark Tide, they could merge themselves with Ovathrax and gain a complete rebirth as Abby contains the dormant powers of Ovathrax within them.

Aemeath and Luuk Herssen reveal that Aleph-1 does not originate from Solaris-3 and is in fact a Threnodian from space. This suggests other Threnodians exist beyond the planet, with implications that the Lament may in fact not be a local phenomenon confined to Solaris-3, but across the universe. This is backed by the existence of The White Tower, another ancient Threnodian sealed within the Somnoire that is implied to have arrived on Solaris-3 from space.

title: Threnodian
content:
During the Jinzhou crisis, Ovathrax's revival begins unexpectedly. After the defeat of its vanguards, Crownless and Dreamless, by Rover and Jiyan with the support of the Midnight Rangers and other Resonators in Jinzhou, it opted to flee, and its current location is unknown.

According to Black Shores' systems, Ovathrax's revival has triggered similar reactions in other countries, with Rinascita being the only exception, where no frequencies fluctuations related to Threnodians have been detected.

title: Threnodian
content: Aleph-1 is an extraterrestrial Threnodian that was drifting between the space of the Homeland Civilization and Solaris-3, before intercepting the Exostrider Baldur. The two behemoths engaged in battle, with Baldur (after resonating with Aemeath) sealing Aleph-1 above Solaris-3 past the Stridergate, a rare opening in the Etheric Sea that allows access to outer space. Baldur landed in the Roya Frostlands, providing warmth and guidance to the Royan people before becoming dormant.

title: Threnodian
content: During Rover's arrival in Lahai-Roi, Aleph-1 attempted to break past the Stridergate and devour Solaris. After Aemeath sacrificed herself to travel back in time through Voidspace in order to pilot the Exostrider and seal it underneath Sundermere as part of a closed loop, it was pursued and defeated by Rover and the combined efforts of Startorch Academy, the Spacetrek Collective, and the newly-awakened Exostrider. After being defeated by the Exostrider, it was cast out to the edge of the known universe, majorly stalling its return. Further, Denia would sacrifice herself afterwards in order to destroy its last frequency tether to Solaris-3, depriving it of any remaining connections to the planet.

Troupe of Fools
content: As the Primus of the Order of the Deep, Fenrico has used the Pilgrim's Sail as a way to banish those he sees as a threat to the Order's goal of achieving unity. Anyone who disobeys or questions the Order and its doctrine are branded 'Fools', and forced to board a ship to Penitent's End, once a sacred spot for pilgrims before being corrupted by the Dark Tide. Although Fools are told they can find redemption and a place beside the Sentinel through this voyage, they are instead subject to the dangers of the Remnant Clouds, a mist that traps Reverberations that turn into Tacet Discord, and the Dragon of Dirge, whom has been altered by the Order with the help of the Fractsidus to attack all living creatures on sight.

title: Troupe of Fools
content:
As a young boy, Brant curiously questioned the appearance of the Sentinel's statue inside the Cathedral of Mercury, and was immediately branded a Fool and sent on the Pilgrim's Sail. While the other Fools on his ship did their best to shield the child from the reality of their fate, he ultimately watched them die one by one. However, they were able to fight against the Tacet Discord and scavenge enough from their shipwreck to build Fool's Elysium, thus beginning the Troupe of Fools.

In addition to establishing a refuge for themselves and patrolling the coast of Penitent's End island in search of new survivors, they have dedicated themselves to performing as they await the return of the Carnevale. There, they hope to expose the Order's lies through a grand performance, and claim the Laurel for the chance to commune with the Sentinel.

title: Troupe of Fools
content: During What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing, the Troupe of Fools fulfill their goal by performing at the Carnevale with Rover, who claims the Laurel. Following the festival, Fenrico grants the troupe permanent rights within Ragunna.

Waveworn Phenomenon (Chinese: 海蚀现象, "Coastal Erosion Phenomenon") is a collective term used to describe anomalies caused directly by the influence of The Lament in Solaris-3.  These phenomena can vary in scope from minor distortions to widespread ecological and psychic collapse. They are distinguished by their chaotic nature and the presence of Tacet Discords.

title: Waveworn Phenomenon
content: As noted in Post-Lament Anthropocene: Comprehensive Mirror for Historians, The Lament unleashed waves of destruction that had an "erosive" effect upon Solaris-3. This anomalous "erosion" is not only physical but metaphysical, distorting memory, structure, and causality itself.

title: Waveworn Phenomenon
content: These are the generally identified types of Waveworn Phenomenon in Solaris-3:

title: Waveworn Phenomenon
content: Tacet Discord Outbreak (commonly referred to as a TD Outbreak )  is the sudden emergence of Tacet Discords—sentient beings formed from residual chaotic frequency energy under the Waveworn Phenomenon. During an outbreak, Tacet Discords proliferate in areas with intense frequency distortion, instinctively feeding on surrounding frequencies to evolve. Their amorphous forms and behaviors are shaped by the types of frequencies they consume, often leading to unpredictable mimicry and regional disruption.

title: Waveworn Phenomenon
content: Tacet Fields are a form of geographical Waveworn Phenomenon, and are widely believed to be where all Tacet Discords originate. Reverberations fill the air in these locations, linking the world to an unknown space through a white Resonance Cord. They are identifiable geographic anomalies, marked by the visibility of the Etheric Sea and a large, cross-shaped Tacet Mark stamped into the terrain. Tacetite formations erupt from the ground around the mark, and the area exhibits localized gravitational distortions—ranging from floating debris to warped terrain as depicted in Qichi Village. These zones are typically surrounded by Tacet Discords, which linger near the field's perimeter even during periods of inactivity. In some cases, Retroact Rain can also occur in such areas thus creating Phantoms within the vicinity.

title: Waveworn Phenomenon
content: Tacet Fields form through the convergence of the Etheric Sea and enter an initial Dormant phase of relative stability. Rapid formation often results in a longer Dormant period and the eventual emergence of more powerful Tacet Discords.

title: Waveworn Phenomenon
content: Tacetite is a rare substance discovered during the study of Waveworn Phenomena, known for its ability to permanently contain Remnant Energy. This property makes Tacetite a valuable material for crafting weapons used by Resonators against Tacet Discords. It is most commonly found within transdimensional zones rich in Remnant Energy, known as Sonoro Spheres. They are also occasionally found in clusters around Tacet Fields.

title: Waveworn Phenomenon
content: Gravitational anomalies have been consistently observed in regions affected by Waveworn Phenomena, with notable instances recorded across Solaris-3. Prominent examples include areas within Qichi Village, the Port City of Guixu, Norfall Barrens and the vicinity of Avinoleum.

title: Waveworn Phenomenon
content: First depicted in Chapter I Act V: Rewinding Raindrops, Retroact Rain is a documented Waveworn Phenomenon composed of condensed Remnant Energy originating from the Etheric Sea. Due to the inherent property of Remnant Energy of recording events across time and space, exposure to the rain often triggers vivid illusions of past events. Individuals with strong emotional ties to the affected location are more susceptible to intense hallucinations. While generally non-lethal, Retroact Rain acts as a potent attractor for Tacet Discords due to its high Remnant Energy concentration. The presence of a Threnodian can further amplify the phenomenon’s effects as seen during the Battle Beneath the Crescent with the Threnodian, Ovathrax. Notably, the frequencies of individuals who perish within the Retroact Rain become permanently embedded in the rain itself.

title: Waveworn Phenomenon
content: Regionally occurring in the city-states of Rinascita, the Dark Tide is a documented Waveworn Phenomenon that manifests as a dark, swirling mass of clouds that gathers and eventually breaks, pouring down in torrents like a waterfall. Whenever the Dark Tide occurs, it spawns Tacet Discords, and the area around its point of origin becomes a new Tacet Field. Additionally, it was described as a mechanism of mass assimilation and indoctrination associated with the Threnodian, Leviathan. The Dark Tide initially spreads through direct contact, converting organic life into vessels that emit continuous hymns. These transformed entities—often described as the dead who "grow mouths and sing hymns, day and night"—function as agents of psychological contagion, spreading madness and perceptual corruption. Minor manifestations related to the Dark Tide were also introduced in Septimont, specifically the occurrence of the Blightcloud, the High Tide, and the Tidal Blight.

title: Waveworn Phenomenon
content: The Sea Fog that occurs around Rinascita is also considered as part of the Waveworn Phenomenon that is local to the area.

title: Waveworn Phenomenon
content: Occurring in Honami City, Irideglow is rainbow-coloured light which condenses into a physical form during the Sonoro Sphere's periodic Lament outbreaks. Once solidified, it is capable of cutting through and confusing space, capturing and devouring everything it meets. Resonators with long-term exposure to Irideglow have high risk of losing control of their Resonance power, and may even Overclock. Mildly corrupted Irideglow Crystals can be separated using certain methods, freeing the original object trapped within. As Honami City was once located in Ashinohara it may be plausible that Irideglow could occur there, but as of yet it remains a unique phenomenon.

title: Waveworn Phenomenon
content:
Tacet Discords who are affected by Irideglow become stronger while also going berserk at the same time upon crystallization. Chisa theorizes that this is due to the Tacet Discords rejecting outsiders, later confirmed through the appearance of the Chronorift Yakujin, which had used the Irideglow Contamination to control the Tacet Discords to stop anyone from entering the city due to seeing it as its territory.

Sumika also noted that Irideglow can drain the body of heat of anyone that doesn’t originate from Honami City, killing them slowly. This can slowly extend to the entity of Neon Tower pulling away heat to ensure a person cannot survive for extended periods of time inside the building before being fully contaminated and crystallized.

title: Waveworn Phenomenon
content: A regional Waveworn Phenomenon unique to Lahai-Roi, it erupts when Voidmatter concentrations reach a critical threshold, creating a Void Storm. It indiscriminately dissolves all matter and existence within its range, causing widespread devastation. Before it strikes, an atmospheric light known as the Shimmer typically appears, serving as an early warning.

title: Waveworn Phenomenon
content: Occurring in Huating, Mengzhou, Evil Miasma is a documented Waveworn Phenomenon that manifests as acidic black rain, which manifested in Mengzhou following Balanophora's assassination of the original Sentinel Hsin. As described by Suoming, it is capable of "devouring souls." After overtaking an area, it can erode the faces of victims directly exposed to it. After forming the Ten Seals Covenant in Huating, a group of freedom fighters from various walks of Mengzhou's life that sought to purge the Evil Miasma from their hometown, they ultimately succeeded in purging its manifestation.

title: Waveworn Phenomenon
content:
The Bountiful Crescendo Event is also attributed as a Waveworn Phenomenon, where Sonoro Spheres are undergoing an accelerating collapse thus intensifying the energy within, resulting in more valuable materials.
The term Waveworn Phenomenon has multiple official translations, many of which emphasize erosion or metaphysical wear caused by The Lament.
In Simplified and Traditional Chinese and Japanese, the term is written as 海蚀现象 / 海蝕現象, directly translating to "sea erosion phenomenon."
In Korean, it is translated as 비명 이상 현상, which roughly means “Scream Anomalous Phenomenon,” likely referencing Tacet Discords.
The French version, Le Phénomène d'érosion, emphasizes the idea of decay or degradation.
The German translation, Wellengetragenes Phänomen, literally means “wave-borne phenomenon,” echoing the poetic tone of the English version.
The Spanish Fenómeno de Erosionda appears to be a portmanteau of “erosión” (erosion) and “onda” (wave), creatively fusing concept and cause.

It was built atop the ruins of Yuan Fortress after its destruction during the Fortress and Gorges War in collaboration with the Court of Savantae.

One of its mountains is said to have a reclusive martial arts master living at the peak.

title: Xuanfang Wardens
content:
The Xuanfang Wardens are the primary military force of the frontier region of Xuanfang within the province of Mengzhou. They stand as the final bulwark protecting the Hold, alongside the Autopuppets. Legally, their power is derived from the Ministry of War established by Mengzhou City Hall. Among their ranks serve the Xuan Watchers, an elite formation forged to confront only the most formidable Tacet Discords. The Wardens and the Xuan Triad are led by Warden Commander Qiuhong.

The Xuan Paragon Qingxiao is seldom seen within the Hold, yet whenever calamity looms, she always appears to stand as Xuanfang's protector. In response to the disappearances occurring throughout the Hold, Yangyang, an Outrider from Jinzhou, has been temporarily transferred to the Wardens. Serving as one of the Xuan Watchers, she lends her expertise in support of the Land of Xuanfang.
